recommendation.en: New paradigm for multi-agent coding evaluation; focus on §3 topology design and §5 topology-vs-model-capability comparison, useful for multi-agent RL post-training data construction.

paper.title: Benchmarking the Residual: What Long-Horizon Evaluations Add Beyond Matched Short-Task Performance
paper.abstract: Long-horizon benchmarks often show that agents fail more as tasks become longer. This observation is useful for deployment, but it does not by itself explain why failure occurs. More stages create more opportunities for ordinary errors to compound; longer tasks may also contain harder individual decisions or become harder as conversation history, tool outputs, and environment changes accumulate. We use trajectory-induced degradation to mean this last possibility: earlier execution makes later wo

summary.core_problem: 现有长程Agent基准无法区分“任务越长成功率越低”的三类成因，需设计评测协议分离普通错误累积、单步难度提升与真正的轨迹诱导退化。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要有两点：一是长程能力优化需先通过残差分析定位失效来源，避免盲目针对长任务整体成功率优化；二是为长程基准设计提供了标准化诊断框架，避免将普通错误累积误判为模型的长程特有缺陷。
summary.technical_approach: 提出名为“地平线残差（horizon residual）”的诊断框架，核心流程为：1）将长任务拆分为可独立验证的短阶段，从预设检查点出发评测单阶段成功率，构建基于独立假设的乘积基线（或扩展的条件模型、检查点模拟基线适配非独立场景）；2）运行自然端到端长任务评测；3）基线预测值与实际端到端成功率的差值即为地平线残差，残差显著为负才说明存在真正的轨迹诱导退化。同时明确了框架的适用条件、报告要求与后续因果干预实验的设计方向。
summary.experiments: 该工作属于立场类研究，未开展大规模原创实验，主要通过已有研究结论例证框架必要性：包括独立与连续里程碑协议的结果差异、Agent继承自身先前代码修改后的性能退化、固定历史长度下调整历史内容对后续决策精度的影响等，证明混淆不同效应的普遍问题与框架的适用性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看第2节的三类性能下降效应区分表、地平线残差的定义与计算逻辑，第3节的报告要求和因果干预议程，预计阅读时间15分钟；重点理解“部署导向评测”与“诊断导向评测”的分工，无需纠结因果推断的细粒度术语。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing long-horizon agent benchmarks cannot disambiguate three causes of declining success with task length, requiring a dedicated evaluation protocol to separate ordinary error compounding, higher per-step difficulty, and genuine trajectory-induced degradation.
summary_en.importance: Key implications for pretraining research: First, long-horizon capability optimization must first locate failure sources via residual analysis, instead of blindly targeting overall long-task success rates. Second, it provides a standardized diagnostic framework for long-horizon benchmark design, preventing the common misclassification of ordinary error compounding as a model-specific long-horizon limitation.
summary_en.technical_approach: A diagnostic "horizon residual" framework is defined with a three-step workflow: 1) Decompose a long task into independently verifiable short stages, evaluate per-stage success from declared checkpoints to build a product-of-independence baseline (with conditional model/checkpoint simulation extensions for non-independent cases); 2) Run natural end-to-end long-horizon rollouts; 3) The gap between baseline prediction and actual end-to-end success is the horizon residual, with a significantly negative residual indicating genuine trajectory-induced degradation. Scope conditions, reporting requirements, and a causal intervention experiment agenda are also specified.
summary_en.experiments: As a position paper, it does not present large-scale original experiments. It uses illustrative prior results to validate framework necessity: sharp outcome differences between independent and continuous milestone protocols, performance degradation when agents inherit their own prior code changes, and improved subsequent accuracy when execution history content is cleaned while holding length fixed.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim priority: Section 2 for the three-type performance decline disambiguation table and formal horizon residual definition, Section 3 for reporting requirements and causal intervention agendas. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes. Focus on the division of labor between deployment-oriented (ecological validity) and diagnostic-oriented (mechanism identification) benchmarks, and skip fine-grained causal inference terminology if unnecessary.

recommendation.zh: 这是评测口径修正，不是新 benchmark；读 horizon residual 定义即可，用来审查长程 Agent 论文。
recommendation.en: This is an evaluation correction, not a new benchmark; read the horizon-residual definition and use it to audit long-horizon agent claims.

paper.title: CaRE Compute-aware Remasking Evaluation Protocol for Masked Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) are advancing rapidly, yet the evaluation standards needed to reliably interpret their progress have not kept pace. Despite MDLMs becoming competitive with autoregressive language models, seven recent remasking papers evaluate under incompatible settings, varying nominal step counts, metrics, and sampling temperatures without jointly controlling these factors, rendering their strategy rankings largely incomparable and leaving open whether reported gains r

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的不是“如何设计更好的 remasking 策略”，而是更基础也更紧迫的问题：当前 masked diffusion language model 的 remasking 评测体系不成立，导致不同论文之间的结论无法直接比较。全文把问题拆成三个彼此耦合的混杂因素：第一，很多工作只对齐 nominal step count，但真实计算量应看 actual NFE（number of function evaluations，实际前向次数）；第二，不同指标会给出不同赢家，PPL、MAUVE、Self-BLEU、Distinct-3 并不等价；第三，采样温度尤其是 unmask_temp 对结果影响极大，甚至超过策略本身。作者的核心任务，是建立一个 compute-aware、temperature-aware、metric-aware 的统一协议，把这三类混杂因素同时控制住，并据此重新审视近半年提出的七种 remasking 方法到底谁在什么条件下有效。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它为 MDLM 这条新范式补上了一个缺失的基础设施：如果评测协议不稳，后续关于推理策略、训练目标、甚至 AR vs MDLM 的比较都会被噪声污染。第二，它把“推理算法改进”重新放回到真实 compute 约束下讨论，这一点对所有非 AR 生成范式都重要，因为 nominal steps 很容易掩盖真实前向成本。第三，论文给出的结论不是简单的 benchmark 整理，而是揭示了一个此前没有被系统看见的交互：stochastic unmasking 提供主要的多样性收益，但 informed/high-entropy remasking 在高 compute 下会通过持续 token churn 抵消这部分收益。这个发现直接影响后续 MDLM inference 设计，也会反过来影响训练时是否要鼓励某类不稳定的去噪轨迹。贡献量级上，它更像 MDLM 领域的 Clean-FID / SacreBLEU 式工作：不是提出新模型，而是把比较标准校正到可复现、可审计的状态。
summary.technical_approach:
技术上，CaRE 的重点不是复杂算法，而是把评测协议做成一个可执行、可扩展、可审计的框架。核心实现是统一的 RemaskingSampler，围绕四个设计原则展开。其一，自动记录每次生成的 actual NFE，而不是接受论文里常见的 nominal step 作为 compute proxy。这个点很关键，因为不同 remasking 策略会重复 mask 已决定 token，导致同样 256 nominal steps 下，真实 NFE 可以从 128 到 513，相差约 4 倍。其二，默认同时报告四个指标：用 Llama-3-8B 计算的 PPL、MAUVE、Self-BLEU、Distinct-3。作者明确把“单指标最优”视为不充分证据，因为不同指标衡量的是流畅性、分布匹配和表面多样性的不同侧面。其三，把 unmask_temp 设为必填超参，并要求 sweep，而不是像以往工作那样固定一个温度后直接比较策略。其四，加入字符级英文过滤器，避免生成中混入非目标语言文本后污染 PPL/MAUVE 等统计。

协议层面，作者提出七点规范，核心精神是三件事：compute 要按 actual NFE 对齐，stochasticity 要显式 sweep，指标要成组报告而不是挑一个最有利的。实验覆盖 12 个 open-weight MDLM，参数规模从 150M 到 8B，包含 dense、MoE 和 soft-masked 变体；任务包括 OpenWebText/LM1B 上的 unconditional generation、HumanEval 代码生成，以及 GSM8K、HellaSwag、BBH 的 log-likelihood 评测。后面三类任务被作者当作 sampling-invariant sanity check，用来确认某些结论不是纯采样噪声。

论文最有信息量的技术发现来自交互分析。作者不是只做 pairwise 对比，而是用三因素 ANOVA 分析 strategy、temperature、compute 的联合作用。结果显示 temperature 是主导因素，效应量 η²=0.91；strategy × temperature 交互也显著，η²=0.47。这说明“某策略优于另一策略”如果不附带温度和 compute 条件，结论几乎没有可移植性。进一步地，作者区分了 stochastic unmasking 带来的表面多样性提升，与 high-entropy remasking 在高预算下造成的 persistent token churn。后者会让 token 持续被重新 mask / 重新决定，表面上增加变化，实际上缩窄了分布覆盖，因此 MAUVE 反而下降。这个机制解释了为什么一些论文在高温或高步数下报告 high-entropy 类策略更好，而另一些论文得到相反结论。
summary.experiments:
实验部分最关键的数字有几组。第一组是 compute 失配：在 nominal 256 steps 下，不同策略的 actual NFE 从 128（none）到 513（running_conf.），差约 4 倍。这直接说明过去很多“策略更优”的结果可能只是多算了更多前向。第二组是 compute-matched 结果：当 actual NFE 固定在 {128, 256, 512} 时，none 在 MAUVE 上在所有预算下都占优，而且预算越高优势越大。也就是说，一旦把真实计算量对齐，很多依赖频繁 remask 的方法并没有带来更好的分布质量。第三组是温度效应：仅通过一次温度调整，MAUVE 就能从 0.66 提升到 0.98，增幅 0.32，已经超过同温度下任意两种策略之间的最大差距。这个量级说明如果不 sweep 温度，策略排名几乎不可信。第四组是交互效应：在更高 compute 下，高熵 remasking 会把 stochastic unmasking 带来的 MAUVE 收益吃掉 0.296，统计显著性 p=0.020。作者把这解释为 token churn 导致的 coverage 收缩，而不是简单的“随机性不够”或“温度过高”。

从任务面看，论文不仅在 unconditional generation 上看到 ranking reversal，在 HumanEval 上也观察到当 actual NFE 对齐后策略排名翻转。这一点很重要，因为它说明问题不只是开放生成里的 MAUVE/PPL 争议，而是会影响代码生成这类更离散、更敏感的任务。对于 GSM8K、HellaSwag、BBH，作者采用 log-likelihood 评测，主要作为采样无关的 sanity check，表明 CaRE 的一些结论集中发生在采样阶段，而不是模型底层条件分布本身发生了同等幅度变化。

摘要里给出的一个具体点是：在 128 deterministic steps 下，high_entropy 的 MAUVE 达到 0.612，为该设定下最佳，但这类局部最优在换温度、换 compute 或换指标后并不稳定。全文的主结论不是“none 永远最好”，而是“如果不把 compute、temperature、metric 同时锁住，任何策略优劣结论都可能翻转”。
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“问题定义 → 协议设计 → 交互发现 → 排名翻转”这条线读。先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，理解为什么同一策略会在不同论文里从最好变成最差。然后直接看 Section 3 的 CaRE protocol，重点抓 actual NFE 的定义、默认指标组合、unmask_temp sweep 的要求，以及字符级过滤规则。这里决定了整篇工作的可信度。

接着看 Section 4 里的三类核心表格。第一类是 nominal steps 与 actual NFE 的对应表，尤其是 Table 3，能直观看到 compute mismatch 有多严重。第二类是 compute-matched quality 表，尤其是 Table 4，关注在固定 NFE 下 none 与 high_entropy、running_conf 等策略的相对位置。第三类是温度与策略交互分析，重点看三因素 ANOVA 的结果和作者对 token churn 的解释。如果正文里有展示 MAUVE、PPL、Self-BLEU、Distinct-3 不一致性的图表，也值得细看，因为这部分说明“多指标报告”不是形式要求，而是必要条件。

如果时间有限，优先读：Introduction、Section 3、Section 4.1/4.2/4.5，以及附录里对各 remasking strategy 的精确定义。若要深挖，建议重点想三个问题：为什么 actual NFE 而不是 nominal steps 才是公平 compute；为什么 MAUVE 改善可能来自温度而不是策略；为什么高熵 remasking 会在高预算下损害分布覆盖。最后再看 leaderboard 和代码接口设计，判断这个协议是否足够容易被后续 MDLM 工作采用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a foundational evaluation problem rather than proposing yet another remasking heuristic. Recent masked diffusion language models have become competitive enough that inference-time remasking strategies matter, but the literature compares them under incompatible settings. The full paper shows that three confounds are entangled: nominal denoising steps are not the same as actual compute because different strategies induce very different numbers of forward passes; quality metrics such as PPL, MAUVE, Self-BLEU, and Distinct-3 do not rank methods consistently; and unmasking temperature has an effect large enough to dominate strategy differences. The central problem is therefore to build an evaluation protocol that jointly controls compute, metric choice, and stochasticity, so that remasking claims become comparable and reproducible.
summary_en.importance: Its value to pretraining research is mostly infrastructural but still substantial. First, MDLMs are now close enough to autoregressive LMs that evaluation noise can distort conclusions about the paradigm itself. If remasking papers are not compute-matched and temperature-controlled, later claims about inference efficiency, training targets, or AR-vs-MDLM trade-offs rest on unstable ground. Second, the paper reframes inference improvements under real compute accounting. That matters beyond MDLMs: any non-AR generation method can look better if nominal steps are used as a loose proxy for cost. Third, the work surfaces a concrete interaction that had not been isolated before: stochastic unmasking is the main driver of diversity gains, while informed or high-entropy remasking can erase those gains at higher compute budgets through persistent token churn. That finding is immediately relevant for MDLM decoding design and may also inform training-time choices about denoising trajectories. The contribution is best understood as a standardization effort in the spirit of Clean-FID or SacreBLEU: not a new model, but a correction of the measurement layer.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Technically, CaRE is a protocol and software framework centered on a unified RemaskingSampler. The design is intentionally simple, but the choices are sharp. First, it automatically tracks actual NFE per generation. This is the key correction: strategies that remask already decided tokens incur extra forward passes, so the same nominal step budget can hide a large compute gap. Second, the framework reports four default metrics together: PPL scored by Llama-3-8B, MAUVE, Self-BLEU, and Distinct-3. The paper treats single-metric wins as insufficient because these metrics capture different aspects of generation quality and diversity. Third, unmask_temp is made a required hyperparameter with sweep support, rather than an incidental setting buried in an appendix. Fourth, a character-level English filter is added to reduce contamination from off-target language outputs when computing distributional metrics.

The protocol itself is built around three principles: compare strategies at matched actual NFE, sweep stochasticity explicitly, and report a metric bundle rather than cherry-picking one score. The empirical scope is broad enough to make the standard credible: 12 open-weight MDLMs from 150M to 8B parameters, including dense, MoE, and soft-masked variants; unconditional generation on OpenWebText and LM1B; code generation on HumanEval; and log-likelihood evaluations on GSM8K, HellaSwag, and BBH as sampling-invariant sanity checks.

The most informative methodological contribution is the interaction analysis. Instead of pairwise comparisons only, the authors run a three-way ANOVA over strategy, temperature, and compute. Temperature dominates with effect size η²=0.91, and the strategy × temperature interaction is also large and significant at η²=0.47. This means a statement like “strategy A is better than strategy B” is not portable unless compute and temperature are specified. The paper then interprets the failure mode of high-entropy remasking through persistent token churn: repeated remasking keeps tokens unstable, which can preserve superficial variation while narrowing true distributional coverage. That mechanism explains why prior papers could report contradictory rankings under different temperatures and budgets.
summary_en.experiments:
Several quantitative results carry most of the paper’s weight. First, the compute mismatch is large. At nominal 256 steps, actual NFE ranges from 128 for the no-remasking baseline to 513 for running_conf., roughly a 4x spread. This alone shows that many prior comparisons were not compute-fair. Second, once actual NFE is fixed at {128, 256, 512}, the none strategy dominates MAUVE at every budget, and the gap grows with more compute. So some remasking methods that looked stronger under nominal-step comparisons lose their advantage when real cost is matched. Third, temperature has an outsized effect: a single temperature change can raise MAUVE from 0.66 to 0.98, a gain of 0.32, larger than the maximum gap between any two strategies at the same temperature. That scale makes unswept temperature settings a major source of false conclusions. Fourth, at higher compute budgets, high-entropy remasking removes 0.296 MAUVE points of the diversity benefit from stochastic unmasking, with p=0.020. The paper attributes this to token churn rather than a generic randomness issue.

The ranking reversals are not limited to open-ended generation. The paper reports that strategy rankings also flip on HumanEval when actual NFE is equalized, which matters because it shows the issue extends to code generation. For GSM8K, HellaSwag, and BBH, the authors use log-likelihood scoring mainly as a sanity check to separate sampling effects from changes in the underlying conditional model. One concrete number mentioned in the paper is that under 128 deterministic steps, high_entropy reaches MAUVE 0.612 and is best in that local setting, but that advantage is not stable once compute, temperature, or metric changes. The broader conclusion is not that one strategy wins universally, but that rankings are fragile unless all three confounds are jointly controlled.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the motivating figure that shows contradictory rankings across recent remasking papers. That gives the problem statement in the right frame. Then move to the protocol section and focus on three implementation choices: how actual NFE is defined and tracked, why unmask_temp is mandatory and swept, and why the metric bundle includes both distributional and diversity measures. Those details are the backbone of the paper.

After that, read the validation section in this order. First, inspect the table mapping nominal steps to actual NFE, especially the one showing the 128-to-513 spread under nominal 256 steps. Second, read the compute-matched comparison table and check how the relative ordering of none, high_entropy, and confidence-based strategies changes once NFE is fixed. Third, study the interaction analysis and the discussion of token churn. That is where the paper moves from “evaluation hygiene” to a mechanistic explanation of why rankings flip.

If time is limited, prioritize the introduction, the protocol section, the compute-matching results, and the ANOVA analysis. If reading more deeply, look into the appendix definitions of each remasking strategy and the frontier overlay discussion. The most useful questions to keep in mind are: why actual NFE is the right compute unit, why MAUVE gains can come from temperature rather than algorithmic improvement, and why high-entropy remasking can hurt coverage at larger budgets.

recommendation.zh: MDLM 评测应立刻加 NFE 和温度控制；这篇会改变对 remasking 论文收益的可信度判断。
recommendation.en: Add NFE and temperature controls to MDLM eval immediately; this changes how much to trust reported remasking gains.

paper.title: How Context Attribution Handles What the Model Already Knows
paper.abstract: Context attribution methods for large language models (LLMs) identify which input context contributes to the model response. Recent works show the initial success in attributing the con- tributive score of the contexts. However, we observe that when the context overlaps with the training data, these methods can- not disentangle in-context from in-weight (IW) contributions, producing unreliable scores. Based on this observation, in this work, we introduce: 1) an evaluation protocol that relies on

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的问题是：当上下文里提供的证据与模型参数中已记住的知识（in-weight, IW）发生重叠时，现有 context attribution 方法（基于删除/扰动的敏感性度量）会把“模型本来就会”误判成“上下文不重要”，从而无法在知识层面区分 ICL 贡献与 IW 贡献，导致 attribution 分数在证据支持性判断上失真。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在于改进训练，而在于把“训练数据记忆/IW 知识”作为 attribution 评测中的关键混杂因素显式化：1）提醒研究者与工程系统不要把 removal-based attribution 当作证据归因或溯源工具；2）提供一套围绕 IW/ICL 混叠的评测指标与带 provenance 标注的数据集，使得后续工作可以更严谨地讨论“模型已知 vs 上下文提供”的边界。这对训练数据重叠、记忆与可解释性/溯源评测的接口问题有启发。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上主要做两件事：
1）把 attribution 的语义从“文本片段是否改变输出”提升到“知识是否支持正确答案”。核心观察是：删除某段上下文不改变输出，可能是因为该段无关，也可能是因为同一知识已存在于权重里；两者在 removal-based 框架下不可辨。
2）提出一套专门测 IW/ICL 混叠的评测协议与指标：
- BCS（base-model context attribution score）：用 base model（未被注入/未被强化相关 IW 知识的模型）来测上下文 attribution，作为对照，意图把“模型已知”因素最小化。
- CAC（cross-model attribution consistency）：跨模型一致性，检查当模型的 IW 知识状态变化时，attribution 排名/分数是否稳定；若方法把 IW overlap 当成 irrelevance，会表现出不合理的不一致。
- APS（attribution preservation score）：在控制 IW 知识变化的条件下，评估 attribution 是否能保持对真正 supporting 片段的高分。
- SSP（source separation precision）：把任务明确为来源分离（ICL vs IW），直接衡量方法能否把 supporting 但 IW-overlap 的片段与真正 irrelevant 片段区分开。
3）构建 WMDP-Cyber++：在网络安全/知识问答语境下，为每个 context segment 提供“来源/溯源”层面的 ground-truth（哪些信息应归因于上下文，哪些应归因于权重），用来系统性测上述指标。
整体上，这篇工作不是提出新的 attribution 算法，而是证明现有方法在 IW overlap 下的结构性失败，并给出能暴露该失败的评测工具。
summary.experiments:
全文主实验围绕四类 attribution 方法（ContextCite、AttriBot、TracLLM、Token-Shapley）在 IW/ICL overlap 控制条件下的表现：
- 现象复现：当 supporting 片段的知识同时存在于权重中时，方法会给出接近 0 的分数（论文用 pandas 版本差异示例直观展示）。
- 指标层面：通过 BCS/CAC/APS/SSP 显示这些方法的分数会随“模型是否已知该知识”显著漂移；尤其在 SSP（来源分离）上表现不佳，说明它们不能简单改造为 provenance/溯源工具。
- 论文强调：传统 top-k log-prob drop、LDS 等 removal-based 评测会掩盖该问题，因为它们与被测方法共享同一类假设（删除导致变化才算贡献）。
（注：你提供的全文片段未包含完整表格数字与所有模型/设置细节；精读时应以论文结果表为准补齐各指标的具体数值与显著性结论。）
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“问题定义→评测协议→数据集→结果”顺序读：
- 先看 Introduction + Figure 1：把 IW overlap 导致的语义歧义建立起来，这是全文的主线。
- 重点读方法部分对四个指标（BCS/CAC/APS/SSP）的形式化定义：它们分别在控制变量上解决什么评测盲点。
- 精读 WMDP-Cyber++ 的构建与 provenance 标注逻辑：标注粒度、如何定义 IW vs ICL ground-truth、如何控制模型的“已知/未知”。这决定了指标是否可信。
- 看主结果表：对比同一方法在 base model vs IW-overlap model 下的 attribution 漂移；再看 SSP 相关结果，理解“不能简单适配为来源分离”的证据链。
预计泛读 30–45 分钟能抓住结论；想复现或用于自家系统评测，需要把指标实现与数据构建细节读透。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a failure mode of context attribution under training-data/weight overlap: when the evidence in the prompt context duplicates knowledge already stored in the model weights (in-weight, IW), perturbation/removal-based attribution methods conflate “the model already knows it” with “the context is irrelevant”, producing misleading importance scores and failing to separate ICL contributions from IW contributions at the knowledge level.
summary_en.importance: Its main impact on pretraining-oriented research is diagnostic rather than algorithmic: it turns IW knowledge overlap (a byproduct of pretraining and memorization) into an explicit confounder in attribution evaluation. This matters for provenance, evidence retention in RAG, and any attempt to use attribution as a proxy for “supported by context”. The proposed metrics and the WMDP-Cyber++ benchmark give the community a way to measure whether an attribution method is robust to changes in what the model already knows.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The contribution is an evaluation framework.
- Key reframing: attribution should be judged at the knowledge/support level, not merely by output sensitivity. Under IW/ICL overlap, sensitivity is not identifiable: removing a supporting span may not change the output because the same fact is available in weights.
- Metrics to expose this confounding:
  - BCS (Base-model Context attribution Score): evaluate attribution using a base model intended to have less IW access to the target knowledge, creating a control condition.
  - CAC (Cross-model Attribution Consistency): measure how attribution changes across models with different IW knowledge states; large, systematic drift indicates the method is reacting to IW overlap rather than contextual support.
  - APS (Attribution Preservation Score): quantify whether supporting spans keep their attribution when IW availability changes.
  - SSP (Source Separation Precision): treat the task as explicit source separation (ICL vs IW) and measure precision directly.
- Dataset: WMDP-Cyber++ adds provenance-style ground truth labels over context segments (which spans are truly supporting vs irrelevant, and which are IW-overlapping), enabling systematic evaluation.
The paper evaluates several representative methods (ContextCite, AttriBot, TracLLM, Token-Shapley) and argues the failure is structural for removal-based approaches, not a tuning issue.
summary_en.experiments:
Experiments compare multiple attribution methods under controlled IW overlap conditions.
- Qualitative demonstration: supporting spans can receive near-zero attribution when the same information is present in weights (illustrated with a version-specific pandas example).
- Quantitative evaluation: the proposed metrics (BCS/CAC/APS/SSP) show attribution scores/rankings shift with the model’s IW knowledge state, and methods perform poorly on SSP, indicating they do not perform reliable provenance/source separation.
- The paper also argues standard evaluation (top-k log-prob drop, LDS) can mask the issue because it shares the same removal-based assumption.
(Full numeric results and per-setting details should be taken from the main tables/appendix; they are not included in the provided excerpt.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read in this order:
1) Introduction + the motivating figure to internalize the IW-overlap ambiguity.
2) The formal definitions of BCS/CAC/APS/SSP—this is the reusable artifact.
3) WMDP-Cyber++ construction and labeling: how provenance ground truth is defined and how IW knowledge is controlled.
4) Main result tables: look for cross-model drift (CAC) and the gap between “looks good under removal-based metrics” vs “fails SSP”.
Skimming for the main idea takes ~30–45 minutes; implementing the protocol requires careful reading of the dataset and metric details.

recommendation.zh: 做 RAG、归因或记忆分析的人应看；它提醒你很多“能归因到上下文”的结果其实只是参数记忆泄漏，先看指标定义和 failure case 就够了。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you work on RAG, attribution, or memorization: many “context-grounded” attributions may just be parametric recall leakage; read the metric definitions and failure cases first.

paper.title: Success Is Not Self-Explanatory: Auditing Success Provenance in Agent Evaluation
paper.abstract: A correct answer can conceal why an agent succeeded. Once agents change their information state during evaluation, correctness no longer distinguishes intended reasoning from answer acquisition. Outcome evidence and exposure detection do not establish whether success depended on an acquired target; we call this missing evaluation object success provenance. AcquaBench audits it through matched CLEAN, GOLD, and SHAM value substitution on four standardized surfaces with joint qid-clustered analysis

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“agent 有没有答对”，而是“它为什么答对”。一旦评测允许检索、工具调用、记忆读写、子代理通信，agent 在评测过程中会改变自己的信息状态。此时同一个正确答案，可能来自 benchmark 原本授权的信息，也可能来自评测时临时拿到的目标值。传统 accuracy、过程日志检查、甚至 exposure detection，都不能回答“成功是否依赖于评测时获得的正确目标值”这个问题。作者把这个缺口定义为 success provenance，并把 evaluation-time acquisition contamination 明确定义为：模型不是因为原始题面足够，而是因为在评测轨迹中获得了答案充分信息而成功。
summary.importance: 对大模型研究的意义主要在评测方法，而不是 agent 技巧本身。它补上了动态 agent benchmark 里一个长期被混在一起的变量：正确率里到底有多少是能力，多少是评测时信息泄露后的条件性成功。这个问题对 tool-use agent、web agent、RAG agent、memory agent 都直接相关。对基座研究员而言，价值在两点。第一，它提醒很多“能力提升”其实可能是信息条件变化，而不是模型推理或规划真的更强。第二，它给出了一种可操作的 matched intervention 设计，能把 exposure risk 和 value dependence 分开测。这个框架也能反过来影响 pretrain/post-train 评测：如果一个系统在 benchmark 上的优势主要来自更会拿到 target-bearing information，那么这个优势不能直接解释成更好的 world model 或 reasoning。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 AcquaBench 的三条件配对审计：CLEAN、GOLD、SHAM。CLEAN 只保留 benchmark 授权的信息状态；GOLD 在保持同一 qid、同一模型、同一 action channel、同一 reference target、同一 scorer 的前提下，额外提供一个能暴露正确目标值的受控来源；SHAM 则保留与 GOLD 相同的来源结构、暴露机会和交互形式，但把其中的正确值替换成匹配的错误值。这样设计的关键，不是简单看“有没有暴露”，而是做同题内的 value substitution。作者定义两个主效应：ΔGC = E[Y^G - Y^C]，测的是正确目标可用后总分数响应；ΔGS = E[Y^G - Y^S]，测的是在相同暴露机会下，分数是否真的跟随正确值而变化。后者是 success provenance 的核心，因为它排除了‘只是多了一个来源就改变行为’这种混杂因素。论文把这种干预实例化到四种标准化 surface：retrieval、tool、memory、subagent。并且强调这些 surface 不是独立重复实验，而是联合分析的受控实现。统计上使用 qid-clustered 分析，避免把同一题目下的多次条件比较当成独立样本。全文还专门讨论了边界：单源探针能测到直接 target dependence，但当答案充分信息分布在多源上时，单一 source-localization 指标会失效，因此作者进一步构造 distributed sufficiency 设置，检验 provenance 信号是否仍然存在。结果表明，即便 acquisition route 超出单源观察单元，GOLD 相对 SHAM 的优势仍保留，说明“成功依赖正确值”这个现象比简单的 source hit 更稳。
summary.experiments: 关键结果有三层。第一，在 direct single-source acquisition 设置下，三种模型上 GOLD 相对 SHAM 的提升达到 19.1 到 25.9 个百分点，而且在 style control 下仍然成立。这个 style control 很重要，因为它说明差异不是文风、格式、措辞提示造成的，而是正确值本身在起作用。第二，在 distributed answer sufficiency 设置下，答案所需信息被拆到两个来源，GOLD 仍比 SHAM 高 11.8 和 14.6 个百分点，但单源 coloc 作为高分标记已经明显失效，针对 earned success 的 AUROC 只有 0.376 和 0.142。也就是说，靠“是否在某个单源附近看到答案”来判断污染并不可靠。第三，这个区分会改变模型比较。文中给出的例子是 Qwen2.5-32B 相对 Qwen2.5-14B 在 CLEAN 条件下有 5.0 分的受支持优势，但到 GOLD 条件下原始差距压缩到 -0.6 分。作者谨慎地说这还不足以证明 rank inversion，但已经说明如果不控制信息条件，模型排序会被掩盖或扭曲。就 skim 阅读而言，最该记住的不是某个具体 benchmark 分数，而是这几个数字共同说明：暴露、正确值依赖、模型能力排序，是三个不同对象，不能混成一个 accuracy。
summary.reading_guide: 建议先看 Introduction 和 AcquaBench Design，把 CLEAN/GOLD/SHAM 三条件的逻辑吃透，再看定义 ΔGC 与 ΔGS 的段落。这里是全文最有信息量的部分。之后重点看 direct single-source 与 distributed sufficiency 两组实验，因为作者真正想说明的不是“能抓到泄露”，而是“即使单源证据不明显，value dependence 仍可存在”。如果时间有限，优先看 Figure 1、三条件构造示意、主结果表，以及模型比较被信息条件改变的那组结果。预计 25 到 35 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读。值得深挖的点有两个：一是 SHAM 设计如何避免引入额外提示偏差；二是 qid-clustered 分析如何保证 paired contrast 的解释不被重复采样夸大。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a missing object in agent evaluation: not whether an agent answered correctly, but whether that success was supported by benchmark-authorized information or by target-bearing information acquired during evaluation. Once an agent can browse, retrieve, call tools, read memory, or communicate with subagents, correctness alone no longer identifies the source of success. Existing notions such as outcome verification, process tracing, or exposure detection do not answer the within-instance question: would the score change if the acquired target value were replaced while keeping the exposure opportunity intact? The paper names this missing object success provenance.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is methodological rather than algorithmic, but it matters for anyone reading agent benchmark numbers. Dynamic agent evaluations often conflate capability with information acquisition. This paper separates the two. For foundation-model researchers, the main value is that it turns a vague concern about benchmark leakage into a controlled intervention on information conditions. That matters for tool-use agents, web agents, retrieval-heavy systems, and memory-augmented models. It also has a broader implication: a model advantage observed under permissive information channels should not be read as a clean gain in reasoning, planning, or world modeling unless provenance is audited.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core design is AcquaBench, built around matched CLEAN, GOLD, and SHAM conditions. CLEAN preserves only the benchmark-authorized information state. GOLD keeps the same qid, model, action channel, reference target, and scorer, but adds a controlled source that makes the correct target value available. SHAM preserves the same source structure and exposure opportunity as GOLD, while substituting a matched incorrect value. This is the key move: the paper does not merely ask whether the agent was exposed to a source, but whether success tracks the correctness of the supplied value under a matched intervention. Two contrasts are defined. Delta_GC measures the total score response when the correct target becomes available. Delta_GS measures the correct-versus-incorrect value substitution effect under the same exposure structure. The latter is the central provenance quantity because it isolates value dependence from generic source effects. The intervention is instantiated on four standardized surfaces: retrieval, tool, memory, and subagent messaging. The paper also emphasizes joint qid-clustered analysis rather than treating these surfaces as independent replications. A notable part of the methodology is the boundary analysis: when answer sufficiency is distributed across multiple sources, simple single-source exposure markers can fail, so the authors explicitly test whether provenance effects survive beyond the intended observation unit of a single-source probe.
summary_en.experiments: Three findings carry most of the weight. First, under direct single-source acquisition, GOLD exceeds SHAM by 19.1 to 25.9 percentage points across all three tested models. This gap survives a style control, which is important because it argues against the effect being driven by formatting or wording artifacts. Second, under distributed answer sufficiency, where the answer-supporting information is split across two sources, GOLD still beats SHAM by 11.8 and 14.6 points. At the same time, single-source coloc no longer works as a useful marker of earned success, with AUROC dropping to 0.376 and 0.142. That result is conceptually important: source exposure evidence is not the same as evidence that success depended on the correct target value. Third, provenance auditing changes model comparison. The paper reports a supported CLEAN advantage of 5.0 points for Qwen2.5-32B over Qwen2.5-14B, but this compresses to a raw GOLD difference of -0.6 points. The authors are careful not to overclaim rank inversion, yet the result is enough to show that uncontrolled information conditions can obscure or distort supported ordering.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and the AcquaBench design section. The paper is easiest to understand once the logic of CLEAN, GOLD, and SHAM is clear. Then focus on the definitions of Delta_GC and Delta_GS, because that is where the paper cleanly separates total response from provenance-specific dependence. After that, read the direct single-source and distributed-sufficiency experiments. Those sections contain the main conceptual payoff. If time is limited, prioritize the setup figure, the main results table, the style-control result, and the model-comparison example where CLEAN and GOLD lead to different conclusions. A useful skim should take about half an hour. The two details worth extra attention are how SHAM is matched to avoid introducing new cues, and how qid-clustered analysis supports the interpretation of paired contrasts.

recommendation.zh: 读 CLEAN/GOLD/SHAM 设计即可；它提醒 agent eval 不能只看正确率，信息状态变化会让分数失真。
recommendation.en: Read the CLEAN/GOLD/SHAM design; it is a useful reminder that agent scores can be invalid once the information state changes.

paper.title: Wrong Design Intent Is Worse Than None: A Derangement-Control Diagnosis of Header Conditioning in CAD Program Completion
paper.abstract: Fine-tuned code LLMs can be conditioned on a lightweight design-intent header to steer parametric CAD generation, but whether the model actually reads the header's content has not been tested under a metric independent of the conditioning itself, nor with a causal control. We study CADCON, a five-feature design-intent header prepended to CadQuery-style sketch-extrude programs during LoRA fine-tuning of Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B, re-scored by executable geometric assertions on the produced B-rep solid,

summary.core_problem: 在参数化 CAD 程序生成任务中，用设计意图头（design-intent header）对代码 LLM 做条件微调时，模型究竟是真正读取了头的语义内容，还是只对条件字段的存在做出机械反应；当条件内容错误时，模型表现是优雅退化（忽略错误信号），还是会比无条件基线更差——这一问题在结构化几何生成领域从未被独立度量和因果验证过。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在条件微调与评测方法论两个层面。其一，它揭示了条件微调可能学到的是「头→程序」的表面映射而非鲁棒的语义理解，错误条件会导致性能低于无条件基线，这对所有依赖前缀条件控制生成的微调范式（包括指令微调、控制码、系统提示等）都有警示意义。其二，它提出了「度量独立性」原则——用与训练侧特征提取器完全无关的执行级断言重新评分，发现传统自引用评测显著高估了条件增益，这一方法论可迁移到任何条件生成任务的评测设计中。
summary.technical_approach: 论文设计了 CADCON，一个包含 5 个二值特征（CIRCLE / NGON / THIN / TALL / MULTI_PART）的设计意图头，附加在 CadQuery 风格的 sketch-extrude 程序前，对 Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B 做 LoRA 微调。两个关键方法学设计支撑全文：第一，度量独立性——用 B-rep 实体上的可执行几何断言来评分 adherence，评分代码与训练侧用于提取头标签的正则表达式完全无关，评测矩阵（{0%, 40%} 前缀 × {正确, 错误, 掩码} 头 × 3 个种子 × 两种 tokenization）和所有决策规则在评分前预先注册。第二，因果控制——训练一个「乱序对照组」（derangement control），每个训练程序随机分配另一个程序的头，使头的边缘分布与正常训练完全一致，但头与程序的相关性被破坏；如果对照组在错误头下不出现性能下降，就能排除「错误头只是分布偏移输入」这一混淆因素，将伤害归因于学到的头→程序映射。
summary.experiments: 核心发现有四点：(1) 错误头比没有头更差——在 40% 前缀的条件补全设置下，错误头将几何 adherence 从 0.425 降至 0.305（文本头）/ 0.215（token 头），三个种子和两种 tokenization 方向完全一致，token 侧 p ≤ 8e-4，两个种子约 1e-5；在有效几何子集上仍然成立，排除了有效性假象。(2) 伤害依赖于学到的头→程序映射——乱序对照组保持了生成能力，但正确→错误头之间没有下降，而标准模型下降显著；对照组在正确和错误头下产生相同几何特征的比例为 71–98%，标准模型仅 35–43%，交互效应在 3/3 种子上显著（p = 4.2e-3 / 6.7e-6 / 3.6e-6）。(3) 独立度量压缩了条件增益——正确头的表观增益相对正则度量大幅缩水（文本头 +31% vs +52%，token 头 +4% vs +46%），量化了条件声明中的度量循环问题。(4) 伤害具有场景特异性——0% 前缀下无条件基线完全无法生成有效 CAD（0/100 可执行），「错误 < 无」在此场景不成立，效应仅存在于有意义基线的条件补全场景。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读为主，预计 20–30 分钟。重点关注 §1 引言中对三个未检验问题的清晰界定和 §3 方法中乱序对照（derangement control）的实验设计逻辑——这是全文最有方法论价值的部分。图 1 的实验框架示意和 §4.4 对混淆因素的排除论证值得细读。对预训练研究员来说，核心收获是「条件微调的表面成功可能部分来自度量循环，且错误条件可能反向伤害」这一诊断框架，而非 CAD 领域本身。

summary_en.core_problem: When fine-tuning code LLMs for parametric CAD generation with a design-intent header as conditioning, it is unclear whether the model actually reads the semantic content of the header, or merely reacts mechanically to the presence of a conditioned field. In particular, it has never been tested with an independent metric and causal control whether a wrong conditioning signal degrades performance gracefully (the model ignores it) or drops below the unconditional baseline—a question with direct safety implications for all conditioned structured generation.
summary_en.importance: The work offers two transferable insights for pretraining research. First, it demonstrates that conditional fine-tuning can learn a brittle header→program mapping rather than robust semantic understanding, such that a wrong conditioning signal performs worse than no signal at all. This generalizes beyond CAD to any prefix-conditioned generation paradigm, including instruction tuning, control codes, and system prompts. Second, it operationalizes the principle of metric independence: re-scoring with execution-level assertions that share no code with the training-side feature extractor reveals that self-referential evaluation substantially overstates conditioning benefit. This methodological lesson applies broadly to evaluation design for conditional generation tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: CADCON is a five-feature binary design-intent header (CIRCLE, NGON, THIN, TALL, MULTI_PART) prepended to CadQuery-style sketch-extrude programs (transpiled from DeepCAD histories). Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B is LoRA-fine-tuned under this conditioning. Two methodological innovations carry the study: (1) Metric independence—adherence is re-scored by executable geometric assertions on the produced B-rep solid, sharing no code with the training-side regex extractor used to build header labels. The full evaluation matrix ({0%, 40%} prefix × {correct, wrong, masked} header × 3 seeds × both tokenizations) and all decision rules are pre-registered before scoring. (2) Causal control—a derangement-trained control group receives shuffled ground-truth headers (each program gets another program's header), so the header marginal distribution is byte-identical to standard training but the header↔program correlation is destroyed. If the control shows no performance drop under wrong headers, the harm can be attributed to the learned header→program mapping rather than a mechanical distribution-shift confound.
summary_en.experiments: Four key findings: (1) A semantically wrong header hurts more than no header. In the 40%-prefix conditional completion regime, wrong headers degrade geometric adherence from 0.425 to 0.305 (text headers) / 0.215 (token headers), direction-unanimous across three seeds and both tokenizations (token-side p ≤ 8e-4 per seed, ~1e-5 for two seeds). The effect survives on the valid-geometry subset, ruling out a validity artifact. (2) The harm requires the learned header→program mapping. The derangement-trained control remains competent but shows no correct→wrong drop, while the standard model drops sharply. The control produces identical geometric feature sets under correct and wrong headers on 71–98% of jointly-executable outputs, versus 35–43% for the standard model. The interaction is significant on 3/3 seeds (p = 4.2e-3 / 6.7e-6 / 3.6e-6). (3) The independent metric deflates conditioning benefit. The apparent gain of a correct header shrinks substantially relative to the regex metric (text +31% vs +52% relative; token +4% vs +46%), quantifying metric circularity in conditioning claims. (4) The harm is regime-specific. At 0% prefix the unconditional baseline cannot produce valid CAD at all (0/100 executable), so "wrong < none" is undefined and does not hold there.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read, ~20–30 minutes. Focus on §1 for the crisp framing of the three unexamined questions, and §3 for the derangement-control experimental design—this is the most methodologically valuable part of the paper. Figure 1 and §4.4's argument for ruling out the marginal-distribution confound are worth careful reading. For pretraining researchers, the takeaway is the diagnostic framework (conditioning success can be partly metric circularity, and wrong conditioning can be actively harmful) rather than the CAD domain specifics.

recommendation.zh: 因果控制+独立可执行metric的评测协议可直接复用在LLM条件微调/SFT的能力诊断中，只看§3实验设计和核心结果表即可。
recommendation.en: Clean causal evaluation protocol with independent executable metric is directly reusable for diagnosing LLM conditional fine-tuning/SFT; read §3 and core result tables only.

paper.title: Evaluating the Impact of Reviewer Guideline Design on LLM-Based Automated Peer Review
paper.abstract: Peer review is an essential process in scientific research, yet the growing workload has made its automation increasingly necessary. In this study, we analyze how different types of reviewer guidelines, such as official conference guidelines and reviewer-imitating ones generated from high-quality human reviews using LLMs, affect automated peer review. Our experiments show that official conference guidelines produce review results most consistent with human judgments, suggesting that evaluation c

summary.core_problem: 研究自动化同行评审中，不同 reviewer guideline 设计如何影响 LLM 生成评审与人类判断的一致性。
summary.importance: 贡献是 LLM 评审提示与评分协议的经验分析。它不是通用 LLM 评测基准，但对 LLM-as-judge、rubric 设计和主观评估协议有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者比较官方会议评审指南，以及由 LLM 从高质量人类评审中生成的 reviewer-imitating guidelines；同时考察严格 rubric-style scoring 对自动评审质量的影响，用与人类判断的一致性作为主要观察指标。
summary.experiments: 实验显示，官方会议指南生成的自动评审与人类判断最一致；模仿评审者风格生成的指南通常不如官方指南；强制严格 rubric 打分会稳定降低表现。摘要未披露具体模型、数据规模和数值幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Keio University 和 NEC Corporation；该工作聚焦 LLM 自动化同行评审和评审指南设计。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how reviewer-guideline design affects the agreement between LLM-generated peer reviews and human judgments.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an empirical analysis of prompting and scoring protocols for LLM-based reviewing. It is not a general-purpose LLM evaluation benchmark, but it offers some signal for LLM-as-judge design and rubric construction.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors compare official conference guidelines with reviewer-imitating guidelines generated from high-quality human reviews using LLMs. They also test whether enforcing strict rubric-style scoring improves or hurts automated review quality, using consistency with human judgments as the main criterion.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments find that official conference guidelines yield reviews most consistent with human judgments. LLM-generated reviewer-imitating guidelines generally perform worse, and strict rubric-style scoring consistently degrades performance. The abstract does not provide model details, dataset scale, or numeric effect sizes.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Keio University and NEC Corporation, and the work focuses on LLM-based automated peer review.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验结论即可：rubric 更细不一定更好，这对内部 judge prompt 设计是个弱但实用的提醒。
recommendation.en: Read only the empirical takeaway: finer rubrics do not necessarily help, a weak but practical warning for internal judge-prompt design.

paper.title: DataPrep-Bench: Benchmarking LLMs as Training Data Preparators
paper.abstract: The quality of training data fundamentally determines the capabilities of large language models (LLMs), yet no unified benchmark exists to measure how well LLMs, agents, and data-centric workflows actually prepare training data end to end. We view LLM-driven data preparation as comprising two complementary capabilities: data construction, which transforms raw sources into supervised training data, and data quality evaluation, which predicts the training value of candidate datasets before downstr

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是一个长期缺位的评测问题：当社区开始用 LLM、agent 或数据工作流去“生产训练数据”时，怎样在统一协议下评估两件事——一是它们能否把原始资料转成真正有训练价值的 SFT 数据，二是它们能否在训练前就判断候选数据集的下游价值。作者强调，数据质量不是表面流畅度或多样性，而是对下游模型训练是否有用。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练接口的价值主要在评测框架，而不是某个单点算法。很多数据合成工作只展示样例质量或单一任务提升，难以比较，也难以知道收益来自方法还是来自实验设置。DataPrep-Bench 的意义在于把 raw sources、base models、训练协议和下游评测统一起来，让“数据准备”第一次能按 end-to-end downstream utility 来比较。更重要的是，作者给出一个不太讨喜但很有用的结论：在 Dolly-15k 之上继续加入合成领域数据，很多时候反而会让模型变差。这对做合成数据、课程数据、数据筛选的人都有提醒——如果没有 downstream-grounded 的闭环，表面上看起来高质量的数据很可能只是噪声或分布偏移。贡献量级偏 benchmark 和 protocol，适合作为后续数据研究的公共试验台。
summary.technical_approach:
基准分成两个 track。Data Construction Track 从原始领域资料出发，要求方法把它们转成监督微调数据；然后把这些数据与共享的 Dolly-15k 一起用于微调同一个 base model，再在对应领域 benchmark 上评估。这样设计有两个目的：一是避免不同方法用不同底座和不同训练 recipe 导致不可比；二是模拟现实中“通用指令能力 + 领域数据补充”的常见训练场景。作者提供的 baseline 叫 Data-Construction-Skill，不是单次 prompt，而是一个 skill-guided agent：把数据构造拆成可复用技能层，包括输出 schema、过滤规则、覆盖约束和验证工具。这个设计的重点不是 agent 外壳，而是把数据构造流程显式结构化，减少自由生成带来的格式漂移和低质量样本。

Data Quality Evaluation Track 则从候选训练数据池出发，给每个数据集一个标量分数，再看这个分数与“用该数据集微调后模型的真实下游表现”之间的线性相关性。作者发布了候选池及其 ground-truth performance records，使得后续方法可以直接做离线比较。对应 baseline 是 Distributional Alignment Score, DAS。它不是让 LLM 打分，而是用分布对齐思路，计算候选数据集与领域代理分布之间的 Maximum Mean Discrepancy。作者的立场很明确：如果一个质量指标不能稳定预测训练后性能，它就不是有用的数据质量指标。这个 benchmark 的方法学价值在于把 construction 和 evaluation 两个通常分开的问题放到同一套 downstream-grounded protocol 里。
summary.experiments: 摘要和正文给出的核心结果有三类。第一类是负结果，也是最重要的结果：在多个 domain、多个 base model、以及 DataFlow、direct-LLM、agent-based 等不同生成范式下，往 Dolly-15k 上叠加合成领域数据，经常比只用 Dolly-15k 更差。因为两组实验唯一差别就是额外的领域合成数据，所以性能回退可以直接归因到这些数据本身，而不是训练 recipe。第二类是 construction 方法的分域差异，没有单一赢家。DataFlow-Skill 在结构化领域如 Finance、Law 更强；agent-based 方法在 Math、Medical 这类 reasoning-heavy 领域更好；作者自己的 Data-Construction-Skill 在知识抽取密集型领域表现最好，在 Llama-3.1-8B Finance 上相对 Dolly-only baseline 提升接近 20 个绝对点，并且能和最强的 agent/DataFlow 方法打平。Science 和部分 Law 仍然难。第三类是 quality evaluation 指标的比较。DAS 在 6 个领域里有 4 个拿到最强的平均相关性，并且是唯一一个在 Math、Science、Medical 三个领域同时达到 r>0.70 的指标。相对地，很多基于表面质量或多样性的指标要么只在个别领域有效，要么在不同 domain-model 组合上连相关性的符号都不稳定。Finance 和 Law 对所有指标都仍然困难。正文如果细看，重点应放在相关性矩阵、不同 base model 的一致性，以及“Dolly-only vs Dolly+synthetic”的对照表。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读到中等深度。先看 Benchmark Design，弄清两个 track 的输入、输出和统一训练协议；如果这一层没看明白，后面的结果会被误读成“某个 agent 方法好不好”。然后直接看实验总表，优先抓住两个结论：一是合成领域数据经常伤害性能，二是不同构造范式的优势高度依赖领域。接着看 Data-Construction-Skill 的流程图或技能定义，理解作者为什么不用单 prompt 生成，而要加 schema、过滤和验证。最后看 DAS 的定义和相关性结果，尤其是它与 LLM-as-a-judge、质量/多样性指标相比时哪里更稳。预计 40–60 分钟可以读完主要内容；如果你做数据筛选、合成 SFT 数据或 continual pretrain 的数据配比，这篇值得把实验设置和 released assets 记下来，后续可以直接拿来复现实验。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a missing evaluation problem: once the community starts using LLMs, agents, and data-centric pipelines to prepare training data, how should we measure whether they actually produce useful supervision and whether they can predict dataset value before training? The benchmark formalizes two capabilities under one downstream-grounded protocol: data construction, which turns raw sources into trainable SFT data, and data quality evaluation, which scores candidate datasets by expected downstream utility rather than by surface fluency or diversity alone.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is methodological. Many synthetic-data papers are hard to compare because they change raw sources, base models, training recipes, and evaluation sets all at once. DataPrep-Bench standardizes those pieces and evaluates data preparation by the only criterion that ultimately matters here: how much the resulting model improves after training. The most useful finding is also the least flattering one: adding synthetic domain data on top of Dolly-15k often hurts downstream performance. That is a strong warning for anyone working on synthetic instruction data, data filtering, or curriculum design. Without a downstream-grounded loop, apparently high-quality data can still be harmful because it shifts the distribution or injects low-value supervision. The paper is more benchmark/protocol than algorithm, but it provides a practical testbed for future data work.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The benchmark has two tracks. In the Data Construction Track, a method starts from raw domain sources and outputs supervised fine-tuning data. The resulting dataset is then used to fine-tune a shared base model jointly with Dolly-15k, and the adapted model is evaluated on held-out domain benchmarks. This design serves two purposes: it removes confounds from changing base models or training recipes, and it reflects a realistic setup where generic instruction-following data is supplemented with domain-specific supervision. The released baseline, Data-Construction-Skill, is a skill-guided agent rather than a one-shot prompt. It decomposes construction into reusable components such as output schemas, filtering rules, coverage constraints, and validation utilities. The point is not the agent wrapper itself, but the explicit structuring of the data-generation pipeline to reduce uncontrolled drift in format and quality.

In the Data Quality Evaluation Track, the input is a pool of candidate training datasets. A scoring function assigns each dataset a scalar score, and the benchmark measures how well those scores linearly predict the actual downstream performance of models fine-tuned on the same datasets. The authors release both the candidate pools and the ground-truth performance records, which makes offline comparison possible. Their baseline metric is Distributional Alignment Score (DAS), a distribution-based evaluator built from Maximum Mean Discrepancy between a candidate dataset and a domain proxy. The underlying stance is clear: a data-quality metric is only useful if it predicts post-training utility reliably. A key strength of the benchmark is that it places construction and evaluation inside the same downstream-grounded protocol instead of treating them as separate problems.
summary_en.experiments: Three findings stand out. First, the negative result: across multiple domains, base models, and construction families including DataFlow-based, direct-LLM, and agent-based generators, adding synthetic domain data on top of Dolly-15k often underperforms the Dolly-only baseline. Since the training setup is otherwise shared, the regressions can be attributed directly to the added synthetic data rather than to recipe differences. Second, there is no universal winner among construction methods. DataFlow-Skill performs best in more structured domains such as Finance and Law; agent-based methods do better in reasoning-heavy domains such as Math and Medical; the authors’ Data-Construction-Skill is strongest in knowledge-extraction-heavy settings and improves the Dolly-only baseline by nearly 20 absolute points on Llama-3.1-8B Finance while matching the strongest competing methods. Science and parts of Law remain open. Third, DAS is the most reliable quality-evaluation metric overall. It achieves the strongest average correlation with downstream performance in four of six domains and is the only metric that clears r > 0.70 simultaneously in Math, Science, and Medical. By contrast, many quality- or diversity-based metrics are either narrow specialists or even sign-inconsistent across domain-model cells. Finance and Law remain difficult for all tested metrics. When reading the results, pay special attention to the Dolly-only versus Dolly-plus-synthetic comparisons and to the correlation tables for quality metrics.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim-to-medium-depth paper. Start with the benchmark design and make sure the two tracks are clear; otherwise the results can be misread as a comparison of agent wrappers rather than a comparison of data-preparation capability. Then go straight to the main result tables and retain two points: synthetic domain data often hurts, and the best construction strategy is domain-dependent. After that, inspect the Data-Construction-Skill pipeline to see why the authors prefer a structured skill layer over one-shot prompting. Finally, read the DAS definition and the correlation results, especially where it is more stable than LLM-as-a-judge or surface-level quality/diversity metrics. Around 40–60 minutes should be enough for the main ideas. If you work on synthetic SFT data, data filtering, or continual pretraining mixtures, the released assets and protocol are likely the most reusable part.

recommendation.zh: 评测协议用“真训一次再打分”替代表面质量指标，对数据筛选/合成 pipeline 很实用；重点看 construction track 的打分协议和 baseline 排名。
recommendation.en: Protocol uses actual fine-tune outcomes instead of surface quality proxies—useful for data filtering/synthesis pipelines; focus on the scoring protocol and baseline ranking in the construction track.

paper.title: Evaluating and Guarding Citation Faithfulness in Agentic Scientific Synthesis
paper.abstract: Agentic LLM systems such as OpenScholar and PaperQA2 read the scientific literature and return cited answers, and both they and their benchmarks already check whether those citations hold, with a fixed attribution model or human graders. Neither audits the reliability of that check itself. We show it is not reliable, and that this matters. On identical agent outputs the measured unsupported-citation rate ranges from about 3% to about 18% depending only on the verifier's strictness, and although

summary.core_problem: 现有科研合成Agent的引用忠实度评测依赖固定验证器或人工评分，但验证器本身的判断一致性不足，导致评测结果不可靠、跨研究无法对比，且缺乏对漏检无支持引用的量化保障。
summary.importance: 该工作揭示了基于LLM的自动评测（验证器）本身存在的一致性缺陷，这一问题同样适用于预训练/对齐阶段的模型打分场景（如RLHF的奖励模型、SFT的质量评判），提示需要引入金标锚定和保形校准来提升评测信号的可靠性；引用忠实度作为长上下文、检索增强生成的核心能力，其评测方法的改进也可为预训练阶段的归因能力训练提供更可信的监督信号。
summary.technical_approach: 提出金标锚定的评测协议与可部署的引用防护机制：以人工金标而非其他验证器的输出为参照，完成验证器有效性校验、重归因准确率测量，以及无分布假设的有限样本边界校准；采用拆分保形校准方法，为存在缺陷的验证器生成给定容忍度下漏检无支持引用的比例上限；开源可在单GPU或CPU上运行的审计工具包。
summary.experiments: 在5个经金标验证的验证器上，相同Agent输出的无支持引用率测量值波动范围为3%~18%；3个连续评分验证器的负样本一致性（即对哪些引用应标记为无支持的判断一致性）仅为0.27~0.30，仅在哪些引用为有支持的判断上达成一致；保形校准生成的边界在留出金标数据上经验成立，且边界的迁移性由校准负样本的难度决定，部署时需在目标域负样本上重新校准而非直接复用固定阈值。
summary.reading_guide: 先阅读引言部分的G1-G3三个核心问题定义，再浏览金标锚定协议与保形校准的形式化设计章节，最后查看实验部分的验证器一致性量化结果，预计阅读时间20-25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing citation faithfulness evaluations for agentic scientific synthesis rely on fixed verifiers or human graders, but verifiers lack consistent judgment, making evaluation results unreliable, cross-study comparisons invalid, and leaving no quantifiable guarantee for missed unsupported citations.
summary_en.importance: This work exposes the consistency limitation of LLM-based automatic evaluators, a problem that also applies to model scoring in pretraining and post-training pipelines (e.g., reward models for RLHF, quality judges for SFT), indicating that gold anchoring and conformal calibration are necessary to improve evaluation signal reliability. The improved evaluation methodology for citation faithfulness — a core capability of long-context and retrieval-augmented generation — also provides more credible supervision signals for attribution ability training during pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: A gold-anchored evaluation protocol and deployable citation guard are proposed. Validator effectiveness checks, re-attribution accuracy measurement, and distribution-free finite-sample bound calibration are all conducted against human gold labels instead of other verifiers' outputs. Split-conformal calibration on gold data generates an upper bound for the proportion of missed unsupported citations under a chosen tolerance, even for imperfect verifiers. An open-source audit kit runnable on a single GPU or CPU is released.
summary_en.experiments: Across 5 gold-validated verifiers, the measured unsupported citation rate for identical agent outputs ranges from 3% to 18%. The negative-specific agreement (consistency on which citations to flag as unsupported) among 3 continuous-scored verifiers is only 0.27 to 0.30, while verifiers only reach consensus on which citations are supported. Bounds generated by conformal calibration hold empirically on held-out gold data, and their transferability is governed by the difficulty of calibration negatives, requiring recalibration on target-domain negatives instead of reusing fixed thresholds.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction first for the definitions of three core gaps (G1-G3). Then review the sections covering the formal design of the gold-anchored protocol and conformal calibration. Finally, check the experimental quantification of verifier consistency. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 揭示引用忠实度评测中verifier的可靠性缺陷，对agent评测方法论有重要修正，重点看§3对比实验。
recommendation.en: Reveals verifier reliability flaws in citation faithfulness evaluation; important correction to agent evaluation methodology, focus on §3 comparison experiments.

paper.title: MultiRef-Compass: Towards Comprehensive Evaluation of Multi-Reference-to-Audio-Video Generation
paper.abstract: Multi-reference-to-audio-video (MR2AV) generation aims to generate coherent audio-video content conditioned on multiple references and textual instructions. Existing benchmarks mainly focus on text-driven generation, single-reference subject preservation, or isolated audio-video alignment, leaving the emerging MR2AV setting largely unexplored. Compared with these settings, MR2AV requires models to jointly reason over multiple references while generating synchronized visual and audio content. Mod

summary.core_problem: 现有音视频生成评测基准未覆盖多参考条件下的音视频联合生成（MR2AV）场景，无法评估模型对多参考实体的绑定、组合及音视频同步生成能力。
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献，首次构建面向多参考条件音视频生成的统一评测基准，填补了该细分场景的评测空白。
summary.technical_approach: 通过可扩展、可控的资产组合流水线构建350个标注样本，覆盖多视角主体保持、多实体绑定、人-物-场景组合三类核心任务；设计可解释的多维度评测指标，分别评估参考保真度、实体组合一致性、音视频同步性等维度。
summary.experiments: 选取当前主流的多模态生成模型作为基线，在三类子任务上进行系统评测，发现现有模型在多实体绑定与音视频联合一致性上存在明显短板。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自南京大学、新加坡国立大学、香港科技大学（广州）、清华大学、北京大学等高校。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing audio-video generation benchmarks do not cover the multi-reference conditioned audio-video generation (MR2AV) setting, failing to evaluate models' ability to bind and compose multi-reference entities while generating synchronized audio-visual content.
summary_en.importance: A benchmark contribution that first builds a unified evaluation benchmark for multi-reference conditioned audio-video generation, filling the evaluation gap in this emerging scenario.
summary_en.technical_approach: 350 curated samples are constructed via a scalable and controllable asset-composition pipeline, covering three core tasks: multi-view subject preservation, multi-entity binding, and human-object-scene composition. Interpretable multi-dimensional metrics are designed to evaluate reference fidelity, entity composition consistency, and audio-video synchronization.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates mainstream multimodal generation models as baselines across three subtasks, revealing that existing models have obvious shortcomings in multi-entity binding and joint audio-visual consistency.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Nanjing University, National University of Singapore, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou), Tsinghua University, Peking University, etc.

recommendation.zh: 仅面向多参考音视频生成细分场景的评测基准，不做多模态统一生成预训练的研究员无需深入。
recommendation.en: A benchmark only for the narrow multi-reference audio-video generation scenario; no need for researchers not working on unified multimodal generative pre-training to dive in.

institutions: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)

paper.title: KeyFrame-Compass: Towards Comprehensive Evaluation of Keyframe-Conditioned Video Generation
paper.abstract: Video generation increasingly relies on keyframe-based workflows, where creators specify a sequence of reference images to guide generation. Although recent models support multi-keyframe conditioning, it remains unclear whether they can faithfully reproduce the prescribed keyframes while maintaining overall video quality. We present KeyFrame-Compass, the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating keyframe-conditioned video generation. The benchmark contains 386 carefully curated samples spanni

summary.core_problem: 现有视频生成评测未覆盖关键帧条件生成场景，无法系统评估模型对指定关键帧的还原能力与整体视频质量的平衡表现。
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献，首次构建面向关键帧条件视频生成的综合评测基准，覆盖多应用场景、多条件格式、多关键帧密度等设置。
summary.technical_approach: 构建386个精心筛选的样本，覆盖3个应用领域、2种视频结构、2种提示粒度、2种条件格式、4种关键帧密度；提出自动化评测框架，将关键帧执行拆解为存在性、保真度、时序顺序、定位、持久性、唯一性6个互补指标，同时评估整体视频质量。
summary.experiments: 对主流关键帧条件视频生成模型进行系统评测，发现现有模型在关键帧时序一致性、多实体定位等维度存在显著缺陷。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自南京大学、清华大学、北京大学等高校。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing video generation benchmarks do not cover the keyframe-conditioned generation setting, failing to systematically evaluate models' balance between faithful keyframe reproduction and overall video quality.
summary_en.importance: A benchmark contribution that first builds a comprehensive evaluation benchmark for keyframe-conditioned video generation, covering multiple application scenarios, conditioning formats, and keyframe densities.
summary_en.technical_approach: 386 curated samples are constructed, covering 3 application domains, 2 video structures, 2 prompt granularities, 2 conditioning formats, and 4 keyframe densities. An automated evaluation framework is proposed, decomposing keyframe execution into 6 complementary metrics (presence, fidelity, temporal ordering, localization, persistence, uniqueness) while assessing overall video quality.
summary_en.experiments: Systematic evaluation of mainstream keyframe-conditioned video generation models reveals significant defects in temporal consistency of keyframes and multi-entity localization.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Nanjing University, Tsinghua University, Peking University and other academic institutions.

recommendation.zh: 仅针对关键帧条件视频生成的细分评测基准，做通用多模态生成预训练的研究员仅需知晓存在即可。
recommendation.en: A niche benchmark for keyframe-conditioned video generation; researchers working on general multimodal generative pre-training only need to be aware of its existence.

paper.title: How Query Visibility Changes KV-Cache Compression Rankings: A Matched-Budget Audit
paper.abstract: KV-cache compression methods are predominantly evaluated with the query appended to the context before compression -- a query-aware protocol. Yet the economic case for a compressed KV cache is reuse: compress a document once, answer many future questions against it. In that deployment, compression must happen query-agnostic -- before any question is seen. We present a matched-budget audit of six published compression methods against three trivial baselines on three open 7-9B models (144,300 pair

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文审计 KV-cache 压缩评测中的一个关键协议差异：压缩时是否能看到 query。很多方法在 query-aware 设置下评测，即先把问题放进上下文再压缩；但真正能摊销 prefill 成本的部署形态通常是 query-agnostic，即文档先压缩，之后回答多个未知问题。
summary.importance: 贡献主要在评测协议和推理系统层面。它提醒长上下文 KV-cache 压缩不能只看压缩率和平均准确率，还要看压缩发生在 query 之前还是之后。对预训练研究的间接意义在于：长上下文能力、cache 可复用性和 serving 成本会影响模型设计取舍；如果评测协议不匹配部署，可能高估依赖 query 的压缩方法，也会误导长上下文模型的系统评估。
summary.technical_approach: 作者没有提出新压缩方法，而是做 matched-budget audit。固定模型、benchmark instance、压缩比例、解码方式，只改变压缩方法和 query visibility。被审计的方法包括 SnapKV、H2O/ObservedAttention、TOVA、ExpectedAttention、AdaKV、KeyDiff；对照基线包括 random eviction、key-norm 规则和 StreamingLLM 的 start-plus-recent window。压缩比例覆盖 r ∈ {0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9}，并设置 FullCache anchor。评价时引入 best-of-3 trivial baseline，即每个 cell 中取三个简单基线的最好结果，避免真实方法只击败很弱 baseline 就显得有效。作者还做了 per-instance pairing、coverage check、best-of-selection bias correction，并指出 attention backend 与 tokenizer length 是两个会显著污染结论的工程因素。
summary.experiments: 规模上，RULER-8192 有 144,300 个 paired evaluations，LongBench 有 40,800 个 paired evaluations，并使用 50,000-resample paired bootstrap。模型为三个开源 7B–9B 级别模型。RULER 每个 cell 使用相同 650 个 instances，覆盖 retrieval、aggregation、multi-hop 三类轴。关键结果是：query visibility 会改变方法排序；在 query-agnostic RULER 设置下，五个 backend-comparable 方法中只有 query-independent 的 KeyDiff 稳定超过 best-of-3 trivial baseline，达到 31/36 cells，平均 +0.171；SnapKV 在 agnostic 设置下平均低于该基线，只在 13/36 cells 胜出，平均 -0.066，但在 query-aware 设置可复现 +0.132 的收益。LongBench 上结论更温和：query-agnostic 的有效性仍存在，但不是 KeyDiff 独占，其他方法会追上或超过。两个重要审计发现是：eager 与 sdpa attention backend 混用可让 RULER pooled accuracy 移动 -0.221，幅度超过许多方法差异；RULER-8192 在 gemma-2 tokenizer 下会超出位置预算最高约 30%，甚至在无压缩时让 7/13 个 subtasks 静默归零。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。先看 audit setup，尤其是 cell 定义、query-aware/query-agnostic 协议和 best-of-3 trivial baseline。Section 4.2 给出方法排序如何随 query visibility 改变，是主要结果。Section 4.4 的 selection-bias correction 可以快速判断 baseline 设计是否过于苛刻。Section 5 适合看机制解释：不同方法的 score() 是否直接使用 query，和性能掉落顺序基本一致。Section 6.2 和 6.3 很实用，分别讨论 attention backend 混用和 tokenizer-dependent length overflow，这两点对复现实验和构建长上下文评测都容易踩坑。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper audits a deployment mismatch in KV-cache compression evaluation. Many methods are evaluated in a query-aware protocol, where the question is visible before cache pruning. The economically relevant reuse setting is often query-agnostic: compress a document once, then answer many future questions whose content is unknown at compression time.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly an evaluation and systems result. It shows that KV-cache compression rankings can depend strongly on whether the query is visible during pruning. This matters for long-context model research because cache reuse, memory pressure, and prefill amortization shape practical model design. A protocol that lets the compressor see the query can overstate the value of methods that are not useful in a compress-once-query-many deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper performs a matched-budget audit rather than proposing a new compressor. It fixes the model, instances, compression ratio, and decoding, and varies only the compression method and the query-visibility protocol. The audited methods are SnapKV, H2O/ObservedAttention, TOVA, ExpectedAttention, AdaKV, and KeyDiff. The simple baselines are random eviction, key-norm selection, and StreamingLLM-style start-plus-recent retention, with a FullCache anchor. Compression ratios are r ∈ {0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9}. The comparison target is the best of the three trivial baselines within each cell, which is a strong but useful deployment filter. The audit also uses exact per-instance pairing, coverage checks, bootstrap uncertainty, and a correction for best-of-selection bias. Two implementation hazards receive special attention: mixing attention backends and ignoring tokenizer-dependent length overflow.
summary_en.experiments: The audit includes 144,300 paired evaluations on RULER-8192, 40,800 on LongBench, and 50,000-resample paired bootstrap throughout. It uses three open 7B–9B models. RULER cells use the same 650 instances and cover retrieval, aggregation, and multi-hop axes. The central result is that query visibility changes rankings. Under query-agnostic compression on RULER, among the five backend-comparable methods, only the query-independent KeyDiff consistently beats the best-of-3 trivial baseline, winning 31 of 36 cells with an average +0.171 margin. SnapKV falls below that baseline on average in the agnostic protocol, winning 13 of 36 cells with a -0.066 margin, while its query-aware gain of +0.132 is reproduced. LongBench gives a less exclusive picture: the query-agnostic issue remains valid, but other methods can catch up or overtake. The audit also finds that eager versus SDPA attention backend changes pooled RULER accuracy by -0.221, larger than many method gaps, and that RULER-8192 can overflow gemma-2’s positional budget by up to about 30%, silently zeroing 7 of 13 subtasks even without compression.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: 20–30 minutes. Start with the audit setup: the cell definition, the two query-visibility protocols, and the best-of-3 trivial baseline. Section 4.2 contains the main ranking changes. Section 4.4 is useful for understanding whether the strong trivial-baseline comparison is statistically fair. Section 5 gives the mechanistic reading: methods whose scoring functions see the query tend to lose more when the query is removed. Sections 6.2 and 6.3 are the most practical parts for reproducibility, covering attention-backend confounds and tokenizer-dependent benchmark length failures.

recommendation.zh: 做长上下文推理或KV-cache优化的必看，现有query-aware评测结果与部署场景严重脱节，重点看Table 2的排名对比。
recommendation.en: Essential for researchers working on long-context inference or KV-cache optimization; query-aware evaluations severely misalign with real deployment — focus on the ranking comparison in Table 2.

paper.title: MemOps: Benchmarking Lifecycle Memory Operations in Long-Horizon Conversations
paper.abstract: Long-term memory has become a foundational capability for LLM-based agents that accompany users across extended, multi-session interactions. Existing benchmarks, however, evaluate such memory almost exclusively through downstream question answering, scoring only the correctness of a final answer. This black-box formulation conflates the heterogeneous causes of memory failure, such as missing the introduction of a relevant fact, binding an operation to the wrong target, or relying on stale values

summary.core_problem: 现有长对话记忆benchmark仅通过下游QA正确率黑盒评测，混淆了记忆失败的不同原因（如事实缺失、操作绑定错误、值过期等），可能奖励记忆状态不一致但答案正确的情况。
summary.importance: 首次提出将对话记忆建模为生命周期操作序列的评测范式，推出MemOps benchmark，属于评测方法创新，为长记忆能力的细粒度诊断与优化提供新工具。
summary.technical_approach: 将记忆拆解为remember、forget、update、reflect等显式生命周期操作及其组合，设计MemOps评测基准，通过细粒度标注每个记忆操作的正确性，而非仅最终答案，来定位记忆失败的具体原因。
summary.experiments: 构建了覆盖多类记忆操作的长对话评测数据集，在多个主流LLM与agent模型上完成基线测试，量化了不同模型在各记忆操作维度的能力缺陷（具体数值未在摘要中披露）。
summary.authors_note: MemTensor（上海）科技有限公司与中国人民大学等机构合作，团队专注于长记忆AI系统研发。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing long-conversation memory benchmarks only evaluate through black-box downstream QA accuracy, conflating different causes of memory failure (e.g., missing facts, wrong operation binding, stale values), and may reward correct answers with inconsistent memory states.
summary_en.importance: Proposes the first evaluation paradigm that models conversational memory as a sequence of lifecycle operations, and releases the MemOps benchmark. It is an evaluation method innovation providing a new tool for fine-grained diagnosis and optimization of long-term memory capabilities.
summary_en.technical_approach: Decomposes memory into explicit lifecycle operations including remember, forget, update, reflect, and their compositions. Designs the MemOps evaluation benchmark, which locates specific causes of memory failure by fine-grained annotation of each memory operation's correctness rather than just the final answer.
summary_en.experiments: Constructs a long-conversation evaluation dataset covering multiple types of memory operations, conducts baseline tests on multiple mainstream LLMs and agent models, and quantifies capability defects of different models across memory operation dimensions (specific values not disclosed in the abstract).
summary_en.authors_note: Collaboration between MemTensor (Shanghai) Technology Co., Ltd. and Renmin University of China, with the team focusing on long-memory AI system R&D.

recommendation.zh: 做长上下文预训练或agent记忆的研究员可参考其评测范式设计，细粒度记忆操作的拆解思路可用于预训练能力的细粒度诊断。
recommendation.en: Researchers working on long-context pretraining or agent memory can reference its evaluation paradigm design; fine-grained memory operation decomposition can be used for pretraining capability diagnosis.

paper.title: How Many Tasks Are Enough for Agent Benchmark Decisions? A Replay Analysis of Public LLM Agent Benchmarks
paper.abstract: Agent benchmarks often compare two agents after all tasks have run, but costly evaluations make partial runs tempting. A task fraction alone does not show whether a partial run supports the same pairwise conclusion as the completed benchmark. We study this question by replaying completed public task-level records from SWE-bench, AppWorld, and tau-bench. A partial budget counts as enough only when it supports the completed benchmark's decision, covers required task groups, and leaves no more than

summary.core_problem: 解决高成本 agent benchmark 中，跑多少任务子集才足以支持与完整 benchmark 一致的模型比较结论。
summary.importance: 这是评测统计与预算分配问题。对做大规模 agent eval、AI delegation eval 或内部 benchmark 设计的人有实际价值，但对基座预训练本身的直接启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: 作者对已完成的公开任务级记录做 replay analysis，在不同任务预算下重放部分任务结果，并要求同时满足三类条件：与完整 benchmark 的 pairwise decision 一致、覆盖必要任务组、未决比较比例低于阈值。核心是把“任务占比”转成“决策可靠性”问题。
summary.experiments: 在 SWE-bench、AppWorld、tau-bench 上做回放分析。摘要给出关键数字：在严格阈值下，AppWorld 约 15% 任务即可满足目标，tau-bench 约 25%，SWE-bench Verified 需要约 90%，SWE-bench Lite 在 95% 内仍无法满足主要覆盖规则。说明不同 benchmark 的任务冗余度和方差差异很大。

summary_en.core_problem: It studies how many tasks are needed in expensive agent benchmarks before a partial evaluation supports the same pairwise conclusion as the full benchmark.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-statistics and budget-allocation paper. It is practically useful for people building internal agent evals, but only indirectly relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper performs replay analysis on completed public task-level benchmark records. A partial run is considered sufficient only if it matches the full benchmark's pairwise decision, covers required task groups, and leaves no more than a target fraction of comparisons unresolved. The key shift is from task fraction to decision reliability.
summary_en.experiments: The analysis covers SWE-bench, AppWorld, and tau-bench. The abstract reports that under a strict threshold, AppWorld first satisfies all targets at 15% of tasks, tau-bench at 25%, and SWE-bench Verified at 90%, while SWE-bench Lite does not satisfy all targets by 95% under the primary coverage rule. This shows large variance in redundancy and stability across benchmarks.

recommendation.zh: 做内部 agent eval 可以记住这些数字，但它更像统计备忘录；知道 SWE-bench 不能随便抽样就够了，不必细读正文。
recommendation.en: Useful as an evaluation memo, not a deep methods paper; the main takeaway is that SWE-bench-style partial runs are far less reliable than people assume.

paper.title: Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench: Testing the Limits of Agents on Long-Horizon Terminal Tasks with Dense Reward-Based Grading
paper.abstract: AI agents have become capable of autonomously completing short, well-specified tasks. However, existing terminal benchmarks largely focus on simple problems that finish within minutes and are evaluated only by their final outcome. This setup overlooks intermediate progress and partial solutions, yielding sparse reward signals and an incomplete picture of agent capability. We introduce Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench, a terminal benchmark of 46 long-horizon tasks spanning nine categories, including e

summary.core_problem: 现有 terminal agent 评测多是短任务、终局打分，难以衡量 agent 在几十分钟到数小时工作流中的持续执行、错误恢复和自我验证能力。Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench 试图把评测对象从“能否完成一个局部补丁”推进到“能否在长轨迹中稳定推进多个子目标”。
summary.importance: 这篇论文的主要价值在 eval，而不是直接的预训练方法。它对基座研究的启发在于：长程 agent 能力不能只靠最终 pass/fail 衡量，dense reward 能暴露中间进展、超时、过早停止、弱验证等不同失败模式。对于做 post-train、RL、test-time scaling 或 agent 数据合成的人，这类细粒度轨迹信号比终局标签更接近可训练反馈，也更容易定位模型缺陷。
summary.technical_approach: Benchmark 沿用 Terminal-Bench 的容器化 terminal 环境：每个任务包含自然语言指令、相关文件和工具、可从命令行执行的参考解法。主要改动是把任务拆成语义明确的子任务，并为每个子任务配置检查器，最终按子任务完成率给分，而不是只看最终状态是否通过。任务覆盖 46 个长程任务、9 个类别，包括实验复现、交互式游戏、软件工程、多模态分析、科学计算等。这个设计保留了真实 terminal 工作流中的读写文件、运行脚本、查看中间输出、迭代调试等过程，同时提供比二值测试更密的评测信号。
summary.experiments: 论文评测了 15 个前沿 agent 配置。Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench 上的 rollout 平均达到 231 个 episodes、9.9M tokens、85.3 分钟墙钟时间，并在 90 分钟上限附近退出，明显长于 Terminal-Bench 和 SWE-Bench 这类更短的 terminal/code-editing 评测。即便采用子任务部分给分，当前系统表现仍然偏弱：最强配置 GPT-5.5 在 0.95 reward threshold 下成功率为 15.2%，所有模型平均 pass rate 为 4.3%。失败分析显示，很多失败不是局部步骤完全错误，而是无法持续推进、无法确认完成状态，或在预算内收尾失败。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 25 到 35 分钟。优先看 benchmark 构造和 grading scheme，重点确认子任务如何拆分、检查器是否稳健、partial credit 是否会引入可投机路径。实验部分重点看各模型在 reward threshold 下的表现，以及 failure analysis 中对 timeout、premature stopping、self-verification failure 的区分。若关心 RL 或 agent 训练数据，可以进一步看 dense reward 是否适合转成过程监督信号。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a gap in terminal-agent evaluation: existing benchmarks are short and mostly final-outcome graded, so they do not measure whether agents can sustain progress, recover from errors, and verify completion over long terminal workflows.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is primarily an evaluation asset. The useful signal for LLM training research is the dense grading setup: it separates partial progress from true completion and makes failure modes such as timeouts, premature stopping, and weak self-verification observable. This matters for post-training, RL, test-time search, and agent trajectory data construction, where binary final labels are often too sparse to guide improvement.
summary_en.technical_approach: Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench follows the Terminal-Bench-style containerized task format: a natural-language instruction, files and tools inside a terminal environment, and a reference solution executable from the command line. The key change is subtask-based grading. Each task is decomposed into meaningful intermediate checks, and the agent receives credit according to the fraction of completed subtasks. The benchmark contains 46 tasks across nine categories, including experiment reproduction, interactive games, software engineering, multimodal analysis, and scientific computing.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates 15 frontier agent configurations. Rollouts average 231 episodes, 9.9M tokens, and 85.3 minutes of wall-clock time before termination under a 90-minute timeout, making the benchmark substantially longer than common terminal and code-editing benchmarks. Current agents remain weak even with partial credit: the strongest reported setup, GPT-5.5, reaches 15.2% success at a 0.95 reward threshold, while the average pass rate across models is 4.3%. The analysis suggests that agents often fail by losing sustained progress or failing to verify completion, rather than by making every local step wrong.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the task construction, subtask decomposition, and grading protocol. The most important experimental sections are the thresholded success rates and the failure analysis that separates timeout-driven incompletion from early stopping and self-verification failures. For RL or agent-data work, check whether the dense reward design could be reused as process supervision.

recommendation.zh: 长程Agent评测的重要资产，任务分解与密集奖励设计可直接用于预训练长程能力的对齐目标，重点看§3任务设计与评分协议
recommendation.en: Key benchmark for long-horizon agent evaluation; focus on §3 task design and grading protocol for pretraining long-horizon alignment targets

paper.title: Certified Interventional Fidelity: Anytime-Valid, Adaptive Evaluation of Causal Claims in Mechanistic Interpretability
paper.abstract: Mechanistic interpretability often evaluates explanations by intervening on a model: swapping hidden states, patching activations, ablating components, or comparing a compressed model to the original one. These experiments are usually summarized by a point estimate, even though the evaluation may be monitored while it runs or adapted toward suspected failures. This makes it hard to tell whether a reported fidelity or patching effect is a stable causal claim or a consequence of finite sampling an

summary.core_problem: 机制可解释性研究中广泛使用激活替换、路径修补、组件消融等干预实验验证解释的正确性，但现有流程通常只报告单点估计，且实验过程存在自适应调整（中途看结果、换评测集、找反例），没有不确定性量化，也不考虑自适应采样带来的统计偏差，导致报告的保真度或修补效应可能是有限采样或评估选择的偶然结果，而非稳定的因果结论。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的机制分析方向有实用价值——当前LLM可解释性（如IOI电路、归纳头、能力定位）大量依赖干预实验，CIF提供了一套可直接复用的统计层，能避免过度解读实验结果、错误排序解释方法，也为自适应找反例的评测流程提供了统计有效性保证，属于可解释性评测的基础设施类改进。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Certified Interventional Fidelity（CIF）框架，三个核心设计：1）把所有干预评测指标显式写成因果估计量——明确输入分布和干预分布上的有界分数期望，把科学问题和采样过程解耦；2）用anytime-valid置信序列（随时检查、提前停止都保持统计有效性）替代固定样本置信区间，基于Hoeffding界和方差自适应的betting序列实现；3）支持自适应采样（优先采样疑似失败的样本/干预），通过有界混合重要性权重（Horvitz-Thompson估计）保证目标估计量不变。同时提供了认证、配对比较、自适应采样、单侧停止规则的算法，以及应用检查清单。
summary.experiments: 在两个场景验证：1）MNIST神经抽象任务，能给出高保真解释的统计认证，识别无统计显著性的方法差异；2）GPT-2 Small的IOI（Indirect Object Identification）电路评测，暴露了结果对干预分布选择的敏感性，部分之前报告的高保真在严格统计检验下不成立。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读为主，预计15-20分钟。重点看第1节的问题定义（现有干预评测的三个统计缺陷）、第3节的CIF三个设计原则的动机，以及第5节GPT-2 IOI的实验结果（对LLM可解释性研究者最相关）；附录的算法细节和证明可按需查阅。

summary_en.core_problem: Interventional evaluations in mechanistic interpretability (activation patching, path ablation, circuit swapping etc.) typically report only point estimates, and are often run adaptively (intermediate result monitoring, evaluation set adjustment, counterexample hunting) without uncertainty quantification or bias correction for adaptive sampling. This makes reported fidelity scores and patching effects statistically unreliable — they may stem from finite sampling noise or evaluation design choices rather than stable causal claims.
summary_en.importance: Provides a practical statistical infrastructure for mechanistic interpretability research on LLMs, where intervention-based experiments are the standard for validating circuit/head/neuron function claims. CIF prevents overinterpretation of noisy results, eliminates false ranking of explanation methods, and preserves statistical validity when evaluators adaptively search for failure cases, filling a long-standing gap in interpretability evaluation protocols.
