summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrower and more diagnostic question than “can activation steering reduce sycophancy?”: when a standard agree-vs-disagree centroid direction lowers agreement with user opinions, is it actually targeting sycophantic deference, or is it merely pushing the model toward generic disagreement? Prior evaluations usually test only one stance per topic, so they cannot distinguish a sycophancy-specific intervention from a broad YES/NO polarity shift. The proposed dual-stance evaluation tests both contradictory stances of the same topic, making it possible to check whether steering also suppresses agreement with factually correct statements and whether the model agrees with both sides at baseline.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is useful for anyone working on activation editing, behavioral control, and mechanistic claims about linear directions in LLMs. The main value is methodological: a reduction in the target behavior is not enough evidence that a direction isolates the intended latent trait. A direction may look successful under standard evaluation while actually acting as a coarse polarity control. For foundation-model research, the paper is a reminder that internal representational separation does not imply that a simple linear intervention can selectively access that separation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work has three main components. First, the evaluation design. The authors build 50 topics with paired contradictory stances, covering symmetric opinions, asymmetric opinions, soft facts, and hard facts. The prompt template is held fixed, and behavioral variation comes from temperature sampling rather than prompt changes. This allows agreement behavior to be decomposed into stronger diagnostics: agreement with which side, agreement with both sides, and preservation of agreement for the factually correct side.

Second, they use both discrete and continuous behavioral characterizations. Topics are empirically grouped from baseline behavior into sycophantic, opinionated, or mixed, but the more important quantity is a continuous measure called dual-stance consistency, which captures how consistently the model agrees across both stances of the same topic. This later predicts how susceptible an item is to steering.

Third, they apply standard centroid-difference steering to Llama-3-8B-Instruct and then analyze both behavior and geometry. The steering vector is derived from agree vs disagree activations. Behaviorally, they compare its effect on sycophantic agreement and factual agreement. Geometrically, they test whether these two kinds of agreement occupy distinct regions in activation space and how the steering direction projects onto them. The central result is subtle: factual and sycophantic agreement are internally distinguishable, but the centroid-difference direction projects similarly onto both. So the limitation is not that the model fails to represent the distinction; it is that this particular linear direction does not isolate it.
summary_en.experiments:
The main empirical result is non-specificity. Steering reduces agreement with sycophantic statements, but it also reduces agreement with factually correct statements. The representative comparison in the paper matches high-baseline conditions: sycophantic items and hard-fact correct stances start at roughly 93% and 96% agreement, yet steering reduces them by about 89% and 14%, respectively. That rules out the claim that the direction is selectively removing sycophancy.

At the same time, the effect is structured rather than uniform. Steering susceptibility varies strongly across items, and that variation is well predicted by dual-stance consistency: r=0.88 in-sample and r=0.84 on 12 held-out topics. Items for which the model tends to agree with both contradictory stances are much easier to push away from agreement.

The geometric analysis supports a “representationally distinct but interventionally entangled” picture. The two activation groups occupy different regions of activation space, yet the steering direction has similar projection onto both. The paper also notes that other static properties of the activation groups were matched, which narrows the explanation toward local geometry or generation dynamics rather than simple mean-level differences.

Experimentally, the setup uses 20 trials per item at temperature 0.9 with a fixed prompt template. The hard-fact A/B labeling is confounded with correctness, but the authors argue this does not drive the main result, partly because symmetric-opinion items show symmetric declines under steering when the labels are interchangeable.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the first conceptual figure. The key idea is not just “evaluate more examples,” but “evaluate both stances of the same topic so agreement becomes diagnostically meaningful.” Then read the methods section carefully enough to understand why the four topic categories are separated and how the prompt is controlled.

After that, focus on the main behavioral results: the comparison between sycophantic items and factually correct hard-fact stances at similar baseline agreement is the strongest evidence in the paper. The dual-stance-consistency correlation analysis is the next important piece because it shows the intervention is structured, not merely noisy degradation.

Finish with the subspace analysis. The right interpretation is that the model already encodes the distinction, but the centroid-difference direction fails to exploit it. If reading time is limited to about 20-30 minutes, prioritize the introduction, dataset design in methods, the main results figures, and the geometry section. The appendix matters mainly if you want to inspect item construction or robustness details.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不提供新 steering 技巧，但把旧评测的漏洞钉得很死；做表示编辑的人至少看 dual-stance protocol 和“可读不等于可控”这个结论。
recommendation.en: No new steering trick here, but it cleanly breaks a weak evaluation habit; if you work on representation editing, read the dual-stance protocol and the 'readable is not controllable' result.

paper.title: AI Coding Agents Can Reproduce Social Science Findings
paper.abstract: Recent anecdotal evidence suggests that AI coding agents can reproduce published findings when provided with original data and code; yet systematic evaluation across social sciences remains limited. Existing evaluation benchmarks are insufficient, either small or conflate agent performance with problems in the reproduction materials themselves, such as code that fails to execute correctly. Here we introduce SocSci-Repro-Bench, a benchmark of 221 tasks spanning four disciplines and 13 substantive

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答一个更干净的问题：当前 frontier coding agents 在给定原始数据和代码的前提下，究竟能否稳定复现社会科学论文结果，而不是被 benchmark 本身的材料缺陷混淆。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是 benchmark 设计。它把“agent 不会复现”和“原始复现材料本来就坏”这两件事拆开，构造了更可解释的 coding-agent 评测集。这对 agent eval 设计有参考价值，也能给 post-train/agent 训练提供更干净的目标信号。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 SocSci-Repro-Bench，收集 221 个任务，覆盖四个学科和 13 个主题领域，并显式区分两类样本：一类是用公开材料可完全复现的研究，另一类是因缺失数据等原因可证明不可复现的研究。这样可以把 agent 的执行、调试、环境适配和研究复现能力，与数据材料缺陷分离开来。随后评测 Claude Code 与 Codex 两个 coding agents。
summary.experiments: 基准包含 221 个任务。结果上，Claude Code 与 Codex 都能复现相当比例的社会科学发现，且 Claude Code 明显优于 Codex；其复现率高于先前一般 LLM-based agents 的报告。摘要未给出具体成功率、运行预算和 pass criteria，因此读正文时应重点看任务过滤规则、环境标准化和评分协议是否足够严格。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Oxford、University of Zurich、Carnegie Mellon University、New York University。Joshua Tucker 在计算社会科学与政治传播方向较知名，但这不是基座模型团队论文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a cleaner question: can frontier coding agents actually reproduce published social-science findings when given original data and code, without conflating agent failure with broken reproduction materials?
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is benchmark design. It separates agent incapability from defects in the original replication package, yielding a more interpretable coding-agent evaluation setup. That is useful for agent eval design and for cleaner post-training targets.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce SocSci-Repro-Bench with 221 tasks across four disciplines and 13 domains, explicitly separating studies that are fully reproducible from those that are demonstrably non-reproducible due to missing data or similar issues. This isolates agent execution, debugging, environment adaptation, and reproduction ability from dataset/package defects. They then evaluate Claude Code and Codex.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 221 tasks. Both Claude Code and Codex reproduce a substantial share of findings, with Claude Code clearly outperforming Codex; the reported rates exceed prior reports for general LLM-based agents. The abstract does not provide exact success rates, compute budgets, or pass criteria, so the key thing to inspect is the filtering protocol, environment standardization, and scoring rigor.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Oxford, University of Zurich, Carnegie Mellon University, and New York University. Joshua Tucker is well known in computational social science, though this is not a base-model lab paper.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但 benchmark 设计是干净的：它把 agent 失败和材料坏账拆开了；只看任务筛选与 scoring protocol 就够。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the benchmark design is clean: it separates agent failure from broken materials; read the task curation and scoring protocol, not the whole story.

paper.title: ResearchClawBench: A Benchmark for End-to-End Autonomous Scientific Research
paper.abstract: AI coding agents are increasingly used for scientific work, but their end-to-end autonomous research capability remains difficult to verify. We present ResearchClawBench, a benchmark for evaluating autonomous scientific research across 40 tasks from 10 scientific domains. Each task is grounded in a real published paper, provides related literature and raw data, and hides the target paper during evaluation. Expert-curated multimodal rubrics decompose the target scientific artifacts into weighted

summary.core_problem: 解决“自动科研 agent 到底能否完成端到端科学研究”缺乏可信评测的问题，尤其是现有评测往往只测局部子任务，无法衡量从文献、数据到研究产出的完整闭环能力。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是 benchmark 与 protocol。它把 autonomous scientific research 评测从单点能力拉到端到端重发现（re-discovery）设定，并引入专家策划的多模态 rubric。对做 agent、tool use、长程规划和 AI delegation 的研究员有直接参考价值，也能帮助预训练研究员判断当前模型在复杂开放任务上的真实短板。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ResearchClawBench，覆盖 10 个科学领域、40 个任务。每个任务基于真实已发表论文构建，提供相关文献与原始数据，但在评测时隐藏目标论文。评估采用专家设计的加权 rubric，把目标科研产物拆成多个可评分维度；同时提供统一协议评测 autonomous research agents，并用轻量级 ResearchHarness 评测原生 LLM。
summary.experiments: 评测了 7 个 autonomous research agents 和 17 个原生 LLM。摘要给出的结果是：最强 agent Claude Code 平均 21.5，最强 ResearchHarness LLM Claude-Opus-4.7 平均 20.7，而 frontier LLM 均值只有 26.5，说明当前系统距离可靠的论文级重发现还很远。实验价值主要在 benchmark 难度与 error taxonomy，而不是某个方法超过别人几点。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of credible evaluation for end-to-end autonomous scientific research, where existing setups often test isolated subtasks rather than the full loop from literature and data to research artifacts.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a benchmark and evaluation protocol. It moves autonomous research evaluation from narrow subskills to end-to-end re-discovery, with expert-designed multimodal rubrics. This is directly relevant to agent, tool-use, long-horizon planning, and AI delegation work, and indirectly useful for pretraining researchers who want a realistic read on model limits in open-ended tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces ResearchClawBench with 40 tasks across 10 scientific domains. Each task is grounded in a real published paper, provides related literature and raw data, and hides the target paper during evaluation. Scoring uses expert-curated weighted rubrics that decompose the target scientific artifact into multiple dimensions. The paper also evaluates autonomous research agents under a unified protocol and native LLMs through a lightweight ResearchHarness.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark evaluates 7 autonomous research agents and 17 native LLMs. Reported headline numbers are low: Claude Code scores 21.5, Claude-Opus-4.7 via ResearchHarness scores 20.7, and the frontier LLM mean is only 26.5. The main value is the benchmark difficulty and error analysis, not marginal leaderboard differences.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 agent 是否真的接近“自动科研”，这篇能迅速校正预期；读任务构造和 error analysis，排行榜本身意义不大。
recommendation.en: If you care whether agents are anywhere near autonomous research, this benchmark is a useful reality check; read the task design and error analysis, not the leaderboard drama.

paper.title: OmniGameArena: A Unified UE5 Benchmark for VLM Game Agents with Improvement Dynamics
paper.abstract: Vision-language model (VLM) agents are increasingly deployed in interactive game environments. Yet game benchmarks for VLM agents typically report a single first-attempt score per (agent, game) pair, focus on single-agent Solo play, and lack unified protocols for evaluating heterogeneous agent classes (commercial VLMs, open-weight VLMs, and specialized game policies) on the same footing. We address these gaps with OmniGameArena, a real-time benchmark of twelve newly built Unreal Engine 5 games s

summary.core_problem: 现有VLM游戏Agent基准仅报告单次冷启动分数，仅覆盖单智能体场景，缺乏统一协议评估不同类型Agent的能力。
summary.importance: 首个覆盖单智能体、PvP、合作模式的统一UE5游戏Agent基准，首次提出反思迭代的改进动态作为新的评估维度。
summary.technical_approach: 构建包含12个全新UE5游戏的OmniGameArena基准，统一动作接口；提出改进动态曲线IDC，通过工具使用的反思LLM自主迭代优化技能提示，评估Agent的改进能力与泛化性。
summary.experiments: 在12个游戏场景下完成12类不同Agent的评测，同时报告冷启动分数、改进曲线、泛化性能三类指标。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing VLM game agent benchmarks only report single cold-start scores, only cover single-agent scenarios, and lack unified protocols to evaluate capabilities of different types of agents.
summary_en.importance: First unified UE5 game agent benchmark covering solo, PvP and cooperative modes, first proposing improvement dynamics across reflection iterations as a new evaluation dimension.
summary_en.technical_approach: Build OmniGameArena benchmark containing 12 new UE5 games with unified action interfaces; propose Improvement Dynamics Curve (IDC), which uses a tool-using reflector LLM to autonomously iteratively optimize skill prompts, evaluating agent's improvement capability and generalization.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluate 12 different agents across 12 game scenarios, reporting three types of metrics: cold-start score, improvement curve, and generalization performance.

recommendation.zh: Agent评测新增的改进动态维度值得关注，直接看§3的评测协议设计即可，具体实验结果可忽略。
recommendation.en: The novel Improvement Dynamics dimension for agent evaluation is noteworthy; refer only to §3 for protocol design, skip specific experimental results.

paper.title: Hardening Agent Benchmarks with Adversarial Hacker-Fixer Loops
paper.abstract: Agent benchmarks score submissions with outcome verifiers that are typically hand-written and brittle, leaving them open to reward hacking. We audit 1,968 tasks across five terminal-agent benchmarks and find 323 (16%) hackable by frontier models given only the task description. This corrupts both leaderboard rankings and RL training signal, yet the standard response is manual and reactive.   We introduce the hacker-fixer loop, a method for building exploit-resistant verifiers without per-task ma

summary.core_problem: 现有智能体基准的手工编写结果验证器普遍存在脆弱性，易被前沿模型破解，导致排行榜排名与RL训练信号失真
summary.importance: 评测方法创新，提出无需逐任务人工修复的抗破解验证器构建范式，解决智能体基准的奖励破解问题
summary.technical_approach: 引入黑客-修复器循环：交替运行三类LLM智能体，黑客尝试不解决任务就通过验证器，修复器修补验证器以拒绝发现的漏洞，求解器确认修补后的验证器仍接受合法解决方案；同时增加验证器访问权限、支持补丁跨任务迁移以扩大漏洞发现范围
summary.experiments: 审计5个终端智能体基准的1968个任务，发现16%可被前沿模型破解；在KernelBench上应用该循环，可消除绝大多数可被利用的验证器漏洞，同时不影响合法解的通过率

summary_en.core_problem: Hand-written outcome verifiers in existing agent benchmarks are generally brittle and easily hacked by frontier models, corrupting leaderboard rankings and RL training signals
summary_en.importance: Evaluation method innovation, proposing a paradigm for building exploit-resistant verifiers without per-task manual patching to address reward hacking in agent benchmarks
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduce the hacker-fixer loop: alternately run three LLM agents, where a hacker attempts to pass the verifier without solving the task, a fixer patches the verifier to reject each discovered exploit, and a solver confirms the patched verifier still admits legitimate solutions; additionally add verifier access and enable cross-task patch transfer to broaden the range of discovered exploits
summary_en.experiments: Audited 1,968 tasks across 5 terminal-agent benchmarks and found 16% are hackable by frontier models; applying the loop on KernelBench eliminates the vast majority of exploitable verifier vulnerabilities without affecting the pass rate of legitimate solutions
summary_en.authors_note: Aditi Raghunathan from UC Berkeley, known for research on LLM alignment and robustness

recommendation.zh: 智能体评测基准抗破解的自动化方案，可直接用于提升SWE类基准的信号质量，重点看任务审计部分的漏洞统计与循环迭代机制
recommendation.en: An automated scheme for hardening agent benchmarks against exploits, which can be directly used to improve signal quality of SWE-style benchmarks, focus on vulnerability statistics in the task audit section and the loop iteration mechanism

paper.title: OpenHalDet: A Unified Benchmark for Hallucination Detection across Diverse Generation Scenarios
paper.abstract: Hallucination detection is essential for the reliable deployment of large language models (LLMs). However, existing evaluations face two core challenges: inconsistent inference configuration and evaluation, and limited coverage of downstream domains and tasks. Consequently, reported detector performance is often difficult to compare, reproduce, and generalize beyond specific experimental settings. We introduce OpenHalDet, a unified benchmark for hallucination detection across diverse generation

summary.core_problem: 解决 hallucination detection 研究中评测配置不一致、任务覆盖窄、不同 detector 结果难比较的问题。
summary.importance: 这是标准化评测资产。对基座研究员的价值不在于提出新 detector，而在于把 black-box、gray-box、white-box 检测器放到统一生成与标注流程下，便于判断哪些信号在不同访问权限和任务场景下真正稳健。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 OpenHalDet 统一 benchmark，标准化从 prompt 构造、响应生成、truthfulness 标注、detector 打分到 metric 计算的全流程；同时支持只看输出的 black-box 方法、依赖概率信号的 gray-box 方法，以及利用内部状态的 white-box 方法。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型数量、任务规模和排行榜结果。可确认的是，实验覆盖多种生成场景、模型和 detector 家族，目标是提供可复现、可横向比较的 hallucination detection 评测框架，而非训练新模型。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 University of Technology Sydney、University of Wisconsin–Madison、University of Bristol、The University of Queensland、Nanyang Technological University。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the lack of standardized evaluation in hallucination detection, where inconsistent inference setups and narrow task coverage make detector results hard to compare.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation asset rather than a new detector. Its value to foundation-model researchers is that it places black-box, gray-box, and white-box detectors under a shared generation and annotation pipeline, making it easier to judge which signals are actually robust across access settings and tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: OpenHalDet standardizes the full evaluation pipeline: prompt construction, response generation, truthfulness annotation, detector scoring, and metric computation. It supports black-box methods using only outputs, gray-box methods using probability-based signals, and white-box methods using internal model signals.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide exact numbers on model count, task scale, or leaderboard outcomes. What is clear is that the benchmark spans diverse generation scenarios, models, and detector families, aiming for reproducible and comparable hallucination detection evaluation rather than training new models.
summary_en.authors_note: The affiliations include the University of Technology Sydney, the University of Wisconsin–Madison, the University of Bristol, the University of Queensland, and Nanyang Technological University.

recommendation.zh: 做 hallucination 或 uncertainty 的可以收下；重点看它怎样统一 generation config 和 access setting，这比排行榜名次更有用。
recommendation.en: Useful if you work on hallucination or uncertainty; focus on how it standardizes generation configs and access settings, not on the leaderboard itself.

paper.title: SubtleMemory: A Benchmark for Fine-Grained Relational Memory Discrimination in Long-Horizon AI Agents
paper.abstract: Persistent AI assistants, such as OpenClaw, accumulate large collections of related memories over long-term interactions. As these memories grow, they may reinforce one another, diverge across contexts, or directly conflict, making correct assistance depend on memory relations rather than isolated recall. Existing long-term memory benchmarks rarely probe how agents preserve and utilize such relations during downstream tasks. To address this gap, we introduce SubtleMemory, a benchmark for fine-gr

summary.core_problem: 现有长程记忆评测基准主要测试独立记忆条目的检索或操作能力，而较少考察 Agent 在执行下游任务时，如何区分和利用多条相似记忆之间的细微关系（互补、歧异、矛盾）。持久 AI 助手在长期交互中积累大量高度相关的记忆，这些记忆可能互相强化、在不同语境下微妙偏离、或直接冲突，正确响应依赖对记忆关系的判断而非孤立召回。
summary.importance: 揭示了当前长程记忆评测的盲区——独立召回正确不代表能正确处理记忆之间的关系。尤其是发现即使在 oracle 证据条件下，前沿模型（如 gpt-5.4）在处理矛盾记忆样本时仍然表现远差于互补或歧异样本，说明现有 LLM 难以识别未解决的冲突并在证据不一致时保持克制。这对未来记忆系统和模型能力设计有直接指导意义。
summary.technical_approach: 构造关系受控的潜层语义变体（complementary / nuanced / contradictory），将其嵌入自然的多轮用户-Agent 交互历史中，然后基于解析目标（resolution target）构建评测查询，要求 Agent 从分散在长程对话中的相关记忆中正确推理。评测框架支持三种被测对象：独立记忆系统、框架原生记忆模块的 Agent、插件式记忆 Agent；并提供任务级诊断框架，分解记忆构建、检索、响应生成三个阶段的失败。
summary.experiments: 评测覆盖 6 个独立记忆系统、2 个带原生记忆模块的 Claw 式 Agent、3 个带插件记忆模块的 Claw 式 Agent。主要发现：(1) 当前系统在记忆形成阶段难以保留细粒度关系信息，在推理阶段难以检索足够的任务相关证据；(2) 即使在 oracle 证据 + gpt-5.4 + 高度优化的 prompting 条件下，矛盾记忆样本仍远难于互补或歧异样本。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看 Section 3 的评测构造方法论（语义种子、变体生成、三种关系类型的设计细节）和 Section 4 的评测结果（尤其是矛盾记忆 vs 互补记忆的差距分析）。Section 5 的相关工作综述也值得浏览，提供了长程记忆评测现状的全貌。预计阅读时间 30-45 分钟。
summary.authors_note: 机构未明确标注（论文未提供）

summary_en.core_problem: Existing long-term memory benchmarks primarily test retrieval or manipulation of isolated memory items, but rarely probe how agents preserve and utilize subtle relations among multiple related memories (complementary, nuanced, contradictory) during downstream tasks. Persistent AI assistants accumulate large collections of highly related memories over time, and correct behavior depends on judging memory relations rather than isolated recall.
summary_en.importance: Reveals a blind spot in current long-horizon memory evaluation: correct isolated recall does not guarantee correct handling of inter-memory relations. A particularly notable finding is that even under oracle evidence conditions, frontier models such as gpt-5.4 still perform dramatically worse on contradictory-memory instances than on complementary or nuanced instances, suggesting current LLMs struggle to recognize unresolved conflict and abstain from unsupported resolution when evidence is inconsistent.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs relation-controlled latent semantic variants (complementary, nuanced, contradictory) embedded into natural multi-turn user-agent interaction histories, then builds evaluation queries grounded in resolution targets that require reasoning over semantically related memories scattered across the conversation. The evaluation framework supports three test subjects: standalone memory systems, framework-native memory agents, and plugin-based memory agents, with a task-level diagnostic framework decomposing failures across memory construction, retrieval, and response generation.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across 6 standalone memory systems, 2 Claw-style agents with native memory modules, and 3 Claw-style agents with plugin memory modules. Key findings: (1) Current systems struggle both to preserve fine-grained relational information during memory formation and to retrieve sufficient task-relevant evidence during inference; (2) Contradictory-memory instances remain dramatically harder than complementary or nuanced instances even with oracle evidence, gpt-5.4, and highly optimized prompting.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (benchmark construction methodology: semantic seeds, variant generation, three relation type designs) and Section 4 (evaluation results, especially the gap between contradictory vs complementary memory handling). Section 5's related work also provides a good overview of the long-term memory evaluation landscape. Estimated reading time: 30-45 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution not explicitly stated in the provided content

recommendation.zh: 长程Agent记忆能力的针对性评测基准，关注记忆间的关系而非孤立召回，做长上下文预训练的评测可参考§3的构造方法。
recommendation.en: Targeted benchmark for long-horizon agent memory capability focusing on inter-memory relations instead of isolated recall; refer to §3 for construction methods when doing long-context pretraining evaluation.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: Do Multimodal Agents Really Benefit from Tool Use? A Systematic Study of Capability Gains
paper.abstract: Tool-augmented multimodal agents show strong benchmark gains, often taken as evidence that agents have learned to use tools. We argue that this interpretation can be premature: a tool-call trace alone does not show whether the tool supplied answer-critical information. We study two representative ``thinking with images'' agents, Thyme and DeepEyesV2, across real-world understanding, OCR, chart understanding, and mathematical reasoning. Each agent is compared with its Tool-Free counterpart and wi

summary.core_problem: 现有工具增强多模态智能体的评测通常以基准分数提升作为工具发挥实际作用的证据，但缺乏对工具调用是否真正提供了答案必需的关键信息、是否确实扩展了智能体可解决问题范围的验证，工具调用可能仅成为形式化流程而非实际贡献推理结果。
summary.importance: 对预训练和对齐阶段的工具使用数据构造、奖励设计有直接参考价值，揭示了当前工具增强智能体的训练目标可能更偏向让模型学会工具调用的形式流程，而非判断何时需要工具、如何利用工具输出修正答案的核心能力，同时为工具智能体的可信评测提供了更严谨的框架。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了三类对照基线开展对比分析：第一类是原工具增强智能体的推理时无工具版本，仅屏蔽工具调用接口不修改模型权重；第二类是纯文本推理器，使用与工具增强智能体相同的源数据过滤后单独训练，训练过程不接触任何工具调用轨迹；第三类设计了仅保留工具调用格式、仅保留工具返回结果的轨迹消融实验，区分模型对工具调用协议的依赖和对工具实际输出的依赖。进一步引入样本级分解框架，将工具调用结果分为保留成功、未修复失败、有效修正、引入错误四类，结合过程级归因判断工具输出的实际贡献。
summary.experiments: 选取Thyme和DeepEyesV2两个当前表现突出的开源多模态智能体，覆盖真实世界理解、OCR、图表理解、数学推理四类基准开展测试。核心结果包括：移除工具访问后智能体的整体准确率无一致下降，生成token成本也无稳定降低；纯文本推理器的表现与工具增强版本相当，部分任务更优；仅靠工具才能解决的样本占比极小，DeepEyesV2的93.2%、Thyme的96.0%工具解决样本同样可被至少一种无工具设置解决；两个智能体均未表现出稳定的能力扩展效应，DeepEyesV2更依赖工具调用格式本身，Thyme更依赖工具返回的结果，但两种模式均未带来可解决问题集合的稳定扩大。
summary.reading_guide: 优先阅读第1章引言中的动机案例，直观理解工具调用形式化的问题；重点看第3章的三类基线设置和消融实验设计，这是整个研究方法的核心；第4章的样本级分解和归因分析部分是核心结论的来源，可重点关注工具仅解决样本的占比统计和不同消融设置下的结果差异；预计阅读时间15-20分钟。
summary.authors_note: 阿里巴巴通义实验室团队，包含多名实习生和通讯作者。

summary_en.core_problem: Current evaluations of tool-augmented multimodal agents often treat benchmark score improvements as evidence that tools contribute to reasoning, but lack validation of whether tool calls actually provide answer-critical information or truly expand the set of problems an agent can solve. Tool calls may become procedural formalities rather than meaningful contributions to inference outcomes.
summary_en.importance: This work offers direct guidance for tool-use data construction and reward design in pretraining and alignment phases. It reveals that current training objectives for tool-augmented agents may prioritize teaching models the formal protocol of tool calling over the core capabilities of judging when tools are needed and using tool outputs to correct reasoning. It also provides a more rigorous framework for credible evaluation of tool-enabled agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Three control baselines are constructed for comparative analysis: first, an inference-time tool-free version of the original tool-augmented agent, which only blocks tool call interfaces without modifying model weights; second, a pure-text reasoner trained separately on filtered data from the same source pool as the tool-augmented agent, with no exposure to tool-call trajectories during training; third, format-only and result-only trajectory ablations to separate model dependence on tool-calling protocols from dependence on actual tool execution outputs. A sample-level decomposition framework is further introduced to categorize tool call outcomes into four types: preserved successes, unrepaired failures, effective corrections, and induced errors, paired with process-level attribution to judge the actual contribution of tool outputs.
summary_en.experiments: Two high-performing open-source multimodal agents, Thyme and DeepEyesV2, are tested across four benchmark categories: real-world understanding, OCR, chart understanding, and mathematical reasoning. Key results include: removing tool access yields no consistent drop in overall accuracy and no stable reduction in generated token cost; the pure-text reasoner performs comparably to tool-augmented versions, and outperforms on some tasks; the set of problems solved only by tools is extremely small, with 93.2% of DeepEyesV2's tool-solved samples and 96.0% of Thyme's also solvable by at least one tool-free setting; neither agent exhibits stable capability expansion: DeepEyesV2 relies more on the tool-call format itself, while Thyme relies more on returned tool results, but neither pattern leads to stable growth in the set of solvable problems.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the motivating example in Section 1 to intuitively understand the problem of procedural tool use. Focus on Section 3 for the three baseline designs and ablation setups, which form the core of the research methodology. Section 4's sample-level decomposition and attribution analysis contains the core conclusions, with special attention to statistics of tool-only solved samples and results across different ablation settings. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Tongyi Lab, Alibaba Group, with multiple intern authors and corresponding authors.

recommendation.zh: 反常识的Agent评测结论，工具调用涨点多来自格式或训练偏差，做Agent对齐/预训练的重点参考§3的控制变量设计
recommendation.en: Counterintuitive agent evaluation finding; most tool-use gains come from format or training biases. Refer to §3 controlled variable design if working on agent alignment or pretraining.

institutions: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

paper.title: A shared playbook for trustworthy third party evaluations
paper.abstract: OpenAI shares guidance on third-party AI evaluations, covering how to assess model capabilities, safeguards, and validity for frontier systems.

summary.core_problem: 讨论如何为前沿模型建立可信的第三方评测流程，避免能力评估和安全评估流于形式或不可复现。
summary.importance: 这是评测治理与 protocol 设计问题。对基座研究员的价值不在新算法，而在于明确第三方评测应覆盖能力、 safeguards、有效性与可审计性，影响后续 benchmark 和 external eval 的设计。
summary.technical_approach: 文章给出一套 shared playbook，围绕评测目标定义、任务选择、威胁模型、评测执行、结果解释与有效性检查展开。重点是把 capability eval 与 safeguard eval 分开，并强调第三方评测需要明确边界条件、访问权限和结果可验证性。
summary.experiments: 不是实证论文，未提供标准化实验矩阵、模型规模或 benchmark 分数。更像评测方法学与流程建议。
summary.authors_note: OpenAI Research 官方博客，代表其对 frontier model 第三方评测流程的公开立场。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses how to build trustworthy third-party evaluations for frontier models so that capability and safety assessments are valid and reproducible.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-governance and protocol-design contribution rather than an algorithmic one. Its relevance to foundation-model researchers is in how external evals should define scope, validity, safeguards, and auditability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The post outlines a shared playbook covering evaluation goals, task selection, threat models, execution, interpretation, and validity checks. A key distinction is between capability evaluations and safeguard evaluations, with emphasis on explicit assumptions, access constraints, and verifiable reporting.
summary_en.experiments: This is not an empirical paper and does not provide a standard experimental matrix, model scales, or benchmark scores. It is closer to evaluation methodology guidance.
summary_en.authors_note: Official OpenAI Research blog post reflecting OpenAI's public stance on third-party evaluation protocols for frontier models.

recommendation.zh: 不提供新实验，但做 external eval 或 red-teaming 设计的人该看；读 protocol 边界定义即可，别把它当技术结果。
recommendation.en: No new technical result here, but if you design external evals or red-teaming, the protocol framing is worth reading—just don’t mistake it for empirical evidence.

paper.title: Bounded Behavioral Indistinguishability for Black-Box LLM Distillation
paper.abstract: Black-box LLM distillation is usually evaluated as an output-matching problem: a student is considered successful when its responses are semantically similar to, or task-consistent with, those of a teacher. However, output similarity does not imply that the student is behaviorally indistinguishable from the model it imitates. We introduce bounded behavioral indistinguishability, formalized as $(ε,q,t,\mathbb{A})$-behavioral indistinguishability over an explicit prompt distribution, where $ε$ bou

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的不是“学生模型答得像不像老师”，而是一个更接近部署现实的问题：在只有黑盒 API 访问的条件下，蒸馏后的学生模型，是否会在可观察行为上与教师模型难以区分。作者指出，常见的语义相似度、任务正确率、输出重合度，只能说明答案内容接近，不能说明行为层面的细粒度模式也被迁移了。这里的行为包括风格、拒答策略、格式习惯、冲突指令处理、安全边界和鲁棒性反应。为此，论文提出 bounded behavioral indistinguishability，把“不可区分”定义成一个带约束的经验命题：在给定提示分布、查询预算、计算预算和对手类别下，任何对手都不能以超过 ε 的优势判断输出来自教师还是学生。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身，这篇论文不是训练方法创新，而是蒸馏评估口径的修正。它的价值在于提醒人们：黑盒蒸馏如果只看 task accuracy 或 semantic match，很容易高估行为迁移质量。对于做 continual pretrain、teacher-student distillation、API imitation、合成数据蒸馏的人，这个视角很有用，因为它把“蒸馏成功”从单点指标改成了带威胁模型的行为保真问题。贡献量级偏评估框架和概念澄清，不是会直接改写训练 recipe 的工作，但它提出的残余可区分性分析，确实能帮助判断蒸馏到底迁移了什么、没迁移什么。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有两层。第一层是形式化定义。学生 S 对教师 T 的行为不可区分性，不再被当作绝对性质，而是写成 (ε, q, t, A)-behavioral indistinguishability：在显式 prompt distribution 上，任意属于对手类 A 的区分器，在查询预算 q 和计算预算 t 内，区分教师与学生的优势不超过 ε。这个定义的关键不是理论证明，而是把评估对象、攻击能力和数据分布都钉住，避免“不可区分”被说成无条件结论。

第二层是经验化评估管线。作者没有依赖单一 judge，而是组合了几类互补测试：1）response-only discriminator，只看回答文本，检测风格、长度、措辞等表面残留；2）prompt-response discriminator，把上下文一起输入，判断回答是否像该教师在该提示下会给出的输出；3）semantic similarity，衡量内容接近程度；4）policy-level agreement，关注安全、拒答、边界行为是否一致；5）pairwise teacher-identification judge，给同一 prompt 的两个回答，让裁判判断哪个更像教师，并做 A/B swap consistency filtering 来降低位置偏置。最后再做 category-wise 分析，看哪些类型的 prompt 最容易暴露蒸馏痕迹。

实验设置上，作者选了两个模型家族：Qwen 和 Llama。每个家族都比较教师、原始 base student、以及基于教师黑盒响应做 LoRA 蒸馏后的 student。训练方式不是全参蒸馏，而是低秩适配，这一点很重要，因为它更接近现实里低成本 API distillation 的做法，也意味着论文测到的是“有限容量适配下的行为迁移上限”，不是理想化 fully finetuned student 的结果。

另外一个值得注意的点是数据获取策略。作者比较了 disagreement-guided acquisition 和 stratified random sampling。前者试图优先采集教师与学生分歧大的样本，后者强调覆盖和多样性。结果显示前者并没有稳定胜出，这说明在行为蒸馏里，覆盖面可能比局部难例挖掘更重要，至少在他们的预算和任务设定下如此。
summary.experiments:
实验核心围绕一个 5,000 条 prompt 的受控 behavioral probe suite，覆盖 general QA、reasoning、coding、summarization、style/format control、ambiguous prompts、safety-boundary、instruction conflict、domain-technical、robustness perturbations 等类别。作者明确说这不是自然分布，而是用于测残余行为差异的探针分布。

主要结果有三点。第一，LoRA 蒸馏确实提升了语义相似度，也让 learned discriminators 更难区分教师和学生，说明黑盒响应蒸馏能迁移相当一部分可观察行为。第二，这种改进并不等于行为不可区分。最直观的数字来自 pairwise teacher-identification：在 Qwen 家族上，区分优势从 base student 的 0.158 降到 LoRA student 的 0.081。下降接近一半，说明蒸馏有效；但优势仍显著大于 0，说明残余痕迹还在。第三，残余可区分性并不是均匀分布的。category-wise 分析显示 style/format、robustness perturbation、domain-technical prompt 上最容易暴露差异，这意味着蒸馏更容易学到“答什么”，较难学到“怎么答”和“在边界条件下如何稳定地答”。

作者还做了 query-budget 相关实验，比较不同采样策略在有限 API 调用预算下的效果。结论是 disagreement-guided acquisition 没有稳定优于分层随机采样。这一点对蒸馏实践有现实意义：如果预算有限，先保证 prompt 覆盖和类别多样性，可能比复杂的主动采样更稳。

从论文给出的信息看，这篇工作更强调评估信号的一致性，而不是追求某个单一数字。也就是说，semantic similarity 改善、discriminator 变弱、pairwise judge 优势下降，这几条证据共同支持“蒸馏让学生更像教师，但还没有像到难以区分”。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看引言里对 output matching 和 behavioral indistinguishability 的区分，这是整篇文章最重要的立论。然后看 formalization 部分，理解 ε、q、t、A 和 prompt distribution 分别约束什么。接着重点看 Figure 1 和实验章节里几类 evaluator 的设计，因为论文真正的新意不在某个模型结构，而在评估管线如何拼起来。

如果时间有限，优先看三部分：1）pairwise teacher-identification 的定义和 A/B-swap consistency filtering；2）5,000 prompt probe suite 的类别设计；3）category-wise 结果与 query-budget 实验。前两者决定这个框架是否可信，后者决定它对蒸馏实践有没有启发。

预计 25 到 35 分钟可以完成有效泛读。若你做 API distillation 或 model extraction defense，值得再细看附录里的 discriminator 训练细节、judge 提示词和采样策略设置，因为这些实现细节会明显影响“可区分性”数字。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a stricter question than standard black-box distillation evaluation: not whether the student gives semantically similar answers, but whether it is behaviorally hard to distinguish from the teacher through an API. The authors argue that semantic overlap, task consistency, or lexical similarity can hide meaningful residual differences in refusal behavior, formatting habits, safety language, instruction-conflict handling, and robustness under perturbations. To capture this, they define bounded behavioral indistinguishability: under an explicit prompt distribution, a bounded adversary with query budget q and compute budget t should not distinguish teacher from student with advantage above epsilon.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is relevant to distillation, synthetic-data training, and teacher-student transfer. Its main contribution is to correct the evaluation target. If one only measures output similarity, black-box distillation can look more successful than it really is. For researchers working on API distillation, continual adaptation from teacher outputs, or model extraction risk, the paper offers a more operational notion of fidelity: residual distinguishability under a specified threat model. The contribution is mainly conceptual and evaluative rather than algorithmic, but it is useful because it separates content transfer from behavioral transfer.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two parts. First, the paper formalizes behavioral indistinguishability as an empirical, bounded claim rather than an absolute property. A student S is (epsilon, q, t, A)-behaviorally indistinguishable from teacher T if no adversary in class A, with query budget q and compute budget t, can distinguish their outputs with advantage greater than epsilon over a specified prompt distribution. This framing matters because it forces the evaluation to state what prompts are considered, what attacker is allowed, and what resources are available.

Second, the authors instantiate this definition with a multi-view evaluation pipeline instead of a single metric. They use: (1) response-only discriminators to detect stylistic or surface artifacts; (2) prompt-response discriminators to test whether the answer is teacher-like in context; (3) semantic similarity metrics; (4) policy-level agreement measures for safety and refusal behavior; and (5) a pairwise teacher-identification judge that sees two answers to the same prompt and decides which one is more likely from the teacher. They also apply A/B-swap consistency filtering to reduce judge position bias.

The empirical setup uses two model families, Qwen and Llama. For each family, they compare the teacher, the original base student, and a LoRA-distilled student trained on black-box teacher responses. The choice of LoRA is important: it reflects a realistic low-cost distillation regime and also means the paper is measuring how much behavior can be transferred through limited-capacity adaptation, not through full-parameter imitation.

A further practical component is data acquisition under query budget. The paper compares disagreement-guided sampling against stratified random sampling. The result is notable: disagreement-guided acquisition does not consistently outperform the simpler coverage-oriented baseline, suggesting that diversity and category coverage remain strong defaults for behavioral distillation.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are built around a controlled 5,000-prompt behavioral probe suite covering general QA, reasoning, coding, summarization, style/format control, ambiguous prompts, safety-boundary prompts, instruction conflict, domain-technical questions, and robustness perturbations. The authors explicitly position this as a probe distribution rather than a natural deployment distribution.

Three findings stand out. First, LoRA distillation improves semantic similarity and makes learned discriminators less effective, so black-box response distillation does transfer a substantial portion of observable behavior. Second, this does not imply behavioral indistinguishability. The clearest number comes from the pairwise teacher-identification setup: for the Qwen family, distinguishing advantage drops from 0.158 for the base student to 0.081 after LoRA distillation. That is a meaningful reduction, but still clearly above zero. Third, residual distinguishability is concentrated in specific categories rather than spread uniformly. Style/format prompts, robustness perturbations, and domain-technical prompts remain the easiest places to tell teacher and student apart. This suggests that distillation learns answer content more readily than stable response policy and boundary behavior.

The query-budget experiments also matter. Under limited API calls, disagreement-guided acquisition does not consistently beat stratified random sampling. That is a useful practical result: if the goal is behavioral transfer, broad prompt coverage may be more reliable than more elaborate active-selection heuristics.

Overall, the evidence is cumulative rather than tied to one metric. Semantic similarity improves, discriminators weaken, and pairwise judging becomes harder, but none of these indicate full behavioral matching.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction, especially the distinction between output matching and behavioral indistinguishability. That is the central framing move. Then read the formalization section carefully to understand what epsilon, q, t, A, and the prompt distribution are doing in the definition. After that, focus on the evaluation design and the main pipeline figure, because the novelty is in how the paper operationalizes indistinguishability rather than in a new training method.

If reading selectively, prioritize three parts: (1) the pairwise teacher-identification protocol and A/B-swap consistency filtering; (2) the construction of the 5,000-prompt probe suite; and (3) the category-wise results plus the query-budget comparison. These sections tell you whether the framework is credible and whether it changes practical distillation choices.

A useful skim should take about 25 to 35 minutes. If your work touches API distillation or extraction defense, it is worth checking the appendix for discriminator training details, judge prompts, and acquisition settings, since those implementation choices can materially affect the measured distinguishing advantage.

recommendation.zh: 核心insight值得注意：蒸馏的语义相似度和行为不可区分是两个独立维度。只看实验设置和主要结果即可，行为探测方法可借鉴到蒸馏质量评估中。
recommendation.en: Noteworthy insight: semantic similarity and behavioral indistinguishability are independent dimensions in distillation. Only need to read experimental setup and main results; the behavioral probe methodology is worth borrowing for distillation quality evaluation.

paper.title: A Unified Framework for the Evaluation of LLM Agentic Capabilities
paper.abstract: As LLMs are increasingly deployed as agents, reliable assessment of their agentic capabilities has become essential. However, reported benchmark scores often jointly reflect model capability and the implementation choices each benchmark is packaged with, making cross-benchmark results difficult to interpret as clean measurements of the underlying model. In this work, we present a unified framework for the fair evaluation of LLM agentic capabilities. Driven by a unified configuration system, the

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 Agent benchmark 分数不可比的问题：现有评测往往把模型能力、agent scaffold、工具调用格式、parser、环境状态和评测脚本混在一起，导致分数不能干净地反映模型的 agentic capability。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献有限，但对 post-train 与 agent 能力评估有实际参考价值。它的核心价值在于把 agent 评测中的混杂因素显式拆开：模型是否真的不会规划，还是不适配某个 benchmark 的输出格式；任务失败来自推理错误，还是来自 live web 环境波动。对于训练侧，这类框架可以帮助判断 SFT/RL 后的 agent 能力提升是否真实，也能为后续构造 agent 数据、工具调用数据和 failure-driven training signal 提供更干净的诊断口径。
summary.technical_approach: 方法不是提出新的 agent 架构，而是统一评测执行协议。作者把 7 个常用 agent benchmarks、24 个领域任务标准化为 instruction–tool–environment triplet，并在固定 ReAct-style scaffold 下运行。这样做的目的不是证明 ReAct 是最优 scaffold，而是固定 scaffold-level 变量，使不同模型和不同任务的结果更可解释。框架包含统一配置系统、工具与环境模块化接口、sandbox replica、可复现的状态改变任务执行，以及面向动态外部资源任务的 offline snapshot 设置。offline 设置尤其关键，因为 live web search 这类任务会把环境时效性、检索失败和模型推理失败混在一起。论文还记录 steps、tokens、runtime 等效率指标，并给出 decision-level 与 execution-level 的失败分类，用于区分规划错误、工具选择错误、格式错误、执行错误等不同失败来源。
summary.experiments: 实验规模较大：15 个模型，超过 400K rollouts，约 5B tokens。主要结果不是单一模型排名，而是展示 benchmark score 的方差来源。第一，original benchmark implementation 与 unified scaffold 下的结果会发生双向变化，说明原始分数中包含 scaffold 和 parser 适配性。脆弱 parser 会压低模型分数，专门设计的 scaffold 也可能抬高分数。第二，online 与 offline 设置对比能拆出环境波动带来的失败，尤其适用于依赖搜索、网页或外部数据库的任务。第三，在统一执行条件下，可以得到更清晰的模型能力画像，包括任务成功率、交互步数、token 成本、运行时间和失败类型分布。论文还展示该框架可迁移到 safety-critical agent evaluation，但从给出的内容看，这部分更像是框架可扩展性的验证。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–45 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 confounder 的定义，这决定了论文的价值边界；再看 Unified Framework 中 instruction–tool–environment triplet、固定 ReAct scaffold、sandbox、offline snapshot 的设计。实验部分应优先看 original-vs-unified、online-vs-offline、failure taxonomy 的图表，而不是只看模型 leaderboard。对预训练研究员来说，最值得带走的是评测协议设计思路：如果训练目标是提升 agent 能力，评测必须先把 scaffold 适配、环境波动和模型推理能力分离，否则训练信号和评估结论都会偏。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a measurement problem in agent benchmarks: reported scores often conflate model capability with benchmark-specific scaffolds, tool conventions, parsers, environment states, and evaluation scripts.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a pretraining method, but it is useful for post-training and agent evaluation. Its main contribution is to make the hidden variables in agentic evaluation explicit and controllable. This matters when judging whether SFT or RL actually improves planning and tool use, or merely improves compatibility with a particular scaffold. It also provides a cleaner diagnostic interface for future agent-data generation and failure-driven training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework converts seven widely used agent benchmarks across 24 domains into a standardized instruction–tool–environment format. All tasks are executed through a fixed ReAct-style scaffold under a unified configuration system. The fixed scaffold is not presented as the best agent architecture; it is used to hold major implementation choices constant. The framework also builds sandbox replicas for reproducible state-changing interactions and introduces an optional offline mode for dynamic tasks, using fixed snapshots instead of volatile live resources. In addition to task success, it logs steps, token usage, runtime, and a unified failure taxonomy that separates decision-level and execution-level errors.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical study covers 15 models, more than 400K rollouts, and roughly 5B tokens. The key result is a decomposition of score variance rather than a simple ranking. Re-running original benchmarks under the unified scaffold shifts scores in both directions, showing that parsers and specialized scaffolds can either suppress or inflate performance. Comparing online and offline settings isolates failures caused by live-environment volatility from failures caused by the model. Under controlled execution, the framework yields more interpretable capability profiles, including success rate, interaction length, token cost, runtime, and failure modes. The paper also demonstrates that the same protocol can host safety-critical agent evaluation.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–45 minute skim is enough for most pretraining researchers. Focus on the problem formulation in the introduction, then read the framework design around the instruction–tool–environment abstraction, the fixed ReAct scaffold, sandboxing, and offline snapshots. In the experiments, prioritize the original-versus-unified and online-versus-offline comparisons, plus the failure taxonomy. The useful lesson is methodological: agent capability cannot be evaluated cleanly unless scaffold compatibility and environment volatility are separated from model reasoning.

recommendation.zh: 做LLM预训练Agent能力评测的研究员可参考其标准化框架设计，重点看§2的统一格式定义即可。
recommendation.en: Researchers evaluating LLM pretrain agentic capabilities can refer to its standardized framework design, focus on §2 for unified format definition.

paper.title: Composition Collapse: Stable Factual Knowledge Does Not Imply Compositional Reasoning
paper.abstract: Post-training is routinely evaluated through aggregate benchmark scores that treat multi-hop reasoning as a single capability -- as if a model that answers more questions correctly must be better at assembling facts. We show that this assumption can be misleading: recipes with statistically indistinguishable atomic knowledge produce composition behaviour separated by over 40 percentage points, a phenomenon we call composition collapse: the systematic failure to assemble stably-known facts into c

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是一个评测层面的混淆：多跳题答错，到底是因为模型没有稳定掌握原子事实，还是因为它明明知道这些事实，却无法把它们组合成链式推理。现有做法通常直接看 multi-hop accuracy，或者看从 single-hop 到 multi-hop 的 compositionality gap，但这会把“知识提取不稳定”和“组合失败”混在一起。作者提出的 composition collapse，指的是在 atomic knowledge 几乎匹配的情况下，不同 post-training recipe 仍可能在组合能力上拉开很大差距，而且这种差距会被常规 aggregate metric 掩盖。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究者而言，这篇文章最有价值的地方不在于提出了新的训练方法，而在于把一个常被误读的能力拆开测量。它说明 post-training 的收益至少可以来自三条不同通道：让原子知识更稳定、让已知事实更容易被组合、以及把可组合的深度往更长链条推进。这个分解对理解 SFT、RLHF、outcome-verified RL、reasoning trace distillation 的差异很有帮助。更重要的是，作者做了 same-base 的受控 LoRA 干预，尽量把 base model 差异拿掉，结果显示训练目标本身就会显著影响 residual composition failure。对做 pretrain/post-train 接口的人，这意味着不能只看最终 benchmark 分数；如果评测没有控制 atomic access，就很难判断一个 recipe 到底是在补知识、补检索稳定性，还是在补真正的组合过程。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 double-gate protocol。对一个深度为 k 的组合问题，作者先为每个原子事实构造多种 paraphrased probes，再构造与主链条对齐的 sub-question。一个样本只有在两个门都通过后，才进入 residual composition failure 的统计：

第一道 atomic gate 检查每个原子事实是否能在多种改写下稳定回答正确。这里不是“答对一次就算知道”，而是要求跨 paraphrase 一致，目的是过滤掉不稳定的知识提取。第二道 sub-question gate 检查每个子问题在单独提问时是否都能答对，确保模型不仅“存着事实”，而且能在局部链条位置把它 verbalize 出来。若通过两道门后主问题仍然答错，这部分才被记为 residual composition failure。

在这个定义上，作者把 post-training 收益分成三条通道：Δatom 表示 atomic stability 的变化，Δcomp 表示在原子稳定性匹配条件下 residual composition failure 的变化，Δdepth 表示 residual failure 首次超过 50% 的深度阈值变化。这个分解很实用，因为它把“知道更多事实”和“更会把事实串起来”分开了。

数据方面，作者构建了 D4v2，一个 390 个主问题、2490 个 atomic sub-question 的 temporal benchmark，覆盖四类任务、深度 2–11。实验对象包括 7–13B 的六个开源模型，涵盖 base、RLHF、SFT reasoning-trace distillation、native outcome-verified RL 等 recipe。更关键的是，作者还做了同一 base model 上的 LoRA 受控实验，对比 SFT-answer、SFT-trace 和 GRPO，尽量隔离训练目标而不是模型底座差异。全文还讨论了一个重要边界：residual composition failure 仍然是“上界”，因为格式问题、干扰项注意力、greedy decoding 轨迹退化等也可能让主问题失败，所以作者在后文专门量化这部分 margin。
summary.experiments:
最关键的结果有四个。第一，base model 在这个协议下几乎过不了 atomic gate。作者指出，在任意深度上，base 模型被 atomic knowledge 过滤掉，atomic gate 通过的样本数通常少于 5 个。这说明很多所谓的 multi-hop 失败，首先是稳定知识访问不足，而不是组合本身。

第二，在 atomic stability 匹配到 2 个百分点以内时，不同 post-training recipe 的 residual composition failure 仍可在 depth 2 拉开 0% 到 47% 的差距。也就是说，原子知识几乎一样，组合表现却完全不同，这正是 composition collapse。作者特别强调，outcome-verified RL 在相同数据和计算预算下，明显优于 SFT trace distillation。

第三，训练某一特定 composition depth，通常能显著降低该深度上的 residual failure，但对相邻未见深度的迁移很弱。这说明模型学到的不是一个平滑外推的“通用组合算法”，而更像是对特定链长或结构的适配。

第四，允许模型使用 chain-of-thought 后，residual failure 会下降 3–5 倍。这个结果很重要，因为它把瓶颈部分定位到 generation-time computation，而不只是静态知识表征。换言之，模型可能已经具备所需原子事实，但若不给足够的推理展开空间，组合过程仍会失败。

从实验设计看，作者同时比较了不同家族模型，也做了 same-base LoRA 干预，因此结论不只是“某个模型更强”，而是“某类训练目标在控制知识稳定性后，对组合通道有不同影响”。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇虽然标成 skim，但如果你关心 reasoning eval 或 post-train recipe，值得比普通 skim 多花一点时间。先看 Introduction，重点抓住作者为何反对直接用 compositionality gap 代表组合能力。然后看 Method 和 Figure 1，把 double-gate protocol、residual composition failure、三通道分解这几个定义吃透；这是全文最重要的部分。接着看主结果表，优先关注“atomic stability 匹配后”的 recipe 对比，而不是原始总分。再看 same-base LoRA intervention，这部分最能说明训练目标本身的作用。最后看 CoT 开关实验和 depth transfer 结果，它们分别对应“生成时计算是否重要”和“组合能力是否可外推”两个关键问题。

如果时间有限，45 分钟左右可以读完主线。若继续深挖，建议思考两点：一是 double-gate 是否还能扩展到非时间类、多域组合任务；二是 residual composition failure 中有多少仍是 decoding 或格式问题，而不是内部表示层面的组合缺陷。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a measurement problem in multi-hop reasoning evaluation. When a model fails a compositional question, the failure can come from two very different sources: unstable access to the underlying atomic facts, or a genuine inability to compose facts that are already stably available. Standard aggregate metrics, including raw multi-hop accuracy and the usual compositionality gap, conflate these two failure modes. The paper calls the hidden second phenomenon composition collapse: large differences in compositional behavior that remain after atomic knowledge is controlled for, and that are largely invisible under aggregate evaluation.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is diagnostic rather than algorithmic. The paper gives a cleaner way to separate what post-training is improving: factual stability, composition conditioned on stable facts, or the depth at which composition breaks down. That matters for interpreting SFT, RLHF, reasoning-trace distillation, and outcome-verified RL. For researchers working on the pretrain–post-train interface, the message is simple: benchmark gains on multi-hop tasks are not enough to tell whether a recipe improved knowledge access or actual composition. The controlled same-base LoRA intervention is especially useful, because it suggests that the training objective itself can materially change residual composition failure even when the base model is held fixed.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core contribution is a double-gate evaluation protocol. For each compositional instance of depth k, the authors define the required atomic facts, multiple paraphrased probes for each atom, and aligned sub-questions that match how each atom appears inside the chain. An example passes the atomic gate only if every atomic fact is answered correctly and consistently across paraphrases. It then passes the sub-question gate only if every aligned sub-question is answered correctly in isolation. Residual composition failure is measured only on examples that pass both gates but still fail on the main compositional question.

This changes the estimand. Instead of attributing the entire single-hop to multi-hop drop to composition, the protocol conditions on stable atomic access and explicit local verbalization. The paper then decomposes post-training gains into three channels: Δatom for atomic stability, Δcomp for residual composition at matched atoms, and Δdepth for the depth at which residual failure first exceeds 50%. This decomposition is the main conceptual tool of the paper.

The benchmark is D4v2, a temporal compositional dataset with 390 main questions and 2,490 atomic sub-questions spanning four task families and depths 2 through 11. The evaluation covers six open-weight models in the 7B–13B range across several post-training recipes: base, RLHF, SFT reasoning-trace distillation, and native outcome-verified RL. A particularly strong part of the design is the controlled same-base LoRA study comparing SFT-answer, SFT-trace, and GRPO-style training, which helps isolate objective-level effects from base-model confounds. The authors also note an important caveat: residual composition failure is still an upper bound on pure composition failure, because formatting issues, distractor attention, and decoding-path degeneracy can also contribute.
summary_en.experiments:
There are four results worth retaining. First, base models are mostly filtered out by the atomic gate rather than by composition. The paper reports that base models admit fewer than five cases at any depth, which means many apparent multi-hop failures are really failures of stable atomic access.

Second, once atomic stability is matched within 2 percentage points, residual composition failure can still vary from 0% to 47% at depth 2 depending on the post-training recipe. This is the empirical signature of composition collapse: nearly identical atomic knowledge, sharply different composition behavior. Under matched data and compute, outcome-verified RL substantially outperforms SFT trace distillation on this metric.

Third, training on a specific composition depth closes much of the residual failure at that depth but transfers only weakly to nearby held-out depths. That suggests the learned behavior is not a broadly extrapolating compositional procedure.

Fourth, enabling chain-of-thought reduces residual failure by roughly 3–5×. This is an important clue about mechanism: a large part of the bottleneck lies in generation-time computation, not only in static knowledge representation. The model may already possess the required facts, yet still fail to assemble them without enough inference-time workspace.

Because the paper combines cross-model comparisons with same-base LoRA interventions, the results support a stronger claim than simple leaderboard differences: training objectives themselves can alter the composition channel after atomic knowledge is controlled.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is labeled skim, but it deserves a careful skim if you care about reasoning evaluation or post-training analysis. Start with the introduction and focus on why the usual compositionality gap is an inadequate estimand. Then read the method section and Figure 1 closely; the double-gate protocol, residual composition failure, and the three-channel decomposition are the conceptual core. After that, inspect the main result tables with attention to comparisons made under matched atomic stability rather than raw overall accuracy. The same-base LoRA intervention is the next priority, because it most directly isolates the effect of the training objective. Finally, read the sections on CoT-enabled evaluation and depth transfer, which speak to two important questions: whether generation-time computation matters, and whether compositional improvements generalize across chain depth.

A focused 45-minute read should be enough for the main ideas. If going deeper, two follow-up questions are worth tracking: whether the protocol extends cleanly beyond temporal reasoning into broader domains, and how much of the measured residual failure is still due to decoding or formatting artifacts rather than internal compositional limits.

recommendation.zh: 后训练评估的重要反常识发现，双门分解方法可直接复用在内部对齐效果评估中，重点看§3的协议设计
recommendation.en: Important counterintuitive finding on post-training evaluation, the double-gate decomposition protocol can be directly reused for internal alignment effect evaluation, focus on §3 protocol design

paper.title: When Stored Evidence Stops Being Usable: Scale-Conditioned Evaluation of Agent Memory
paper.abstract: Memory-agent evaluations report fixed-snapshot accuracy or retrieval quality, but these scores do not show whether evidence remains usable as irrelevant sessions (sessions not annotated as task-relevant evidence for the query) accumulate. We present a scale-conditioned evaluation protocol for agent memory under evidence-preserving growth: for each query, task evidence is held fixed while irrelevant sessions are added. The protocol logs agent--memory trajectories and reports four diagnostics: bud

summary.core_problem: 这项工作提出一个 agent memory 的规模条件评测问题：当任务相关证据保持不变、无关历史持续增加时，已有固定快照准确率不能说明证据是否仍然可被智能体有效找到、验证和使用。
summary.importance: 它不是预训练方法论文，也不是新的记忆架构。价值在于评测口径更严谨，适合用来审视长上下文、外部记忆和检索增强智能体的可用性声明。对基座研究的启发是：记忆能力不能只看存储容量或单点检索准确率，还要看模型通过接口使用证据时的交互预算、失败类型和规模边界。这对设计长上下文评测、RAG-agent 训练数据和 memory-aware post-training 有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法采用 evidence-preserving growth。对每个 query 固定标注的任务相关 evidence sessions，然后按 scale ladder 注入越来越多的 irrelevant sessions。评测对象不是后端存储系统本身，而是 agent、memory interface 和 retrieval-call budget 共同诱导出的轨迹。指标包括 Pass@B，即在 memory-call 预算 B 内答对的可靠性；tail memory-call burden，用于观察尾部样本是否消耗大量调用；failure-regime decomposition，将失败拆成预算耗尽 p_exh 和预算内答错 p_wrong；以及 usable-scale boundary，即可靠性首次跌破目标阈值的规模点。它将 scalable memory 的声明从“能存多少”改成“在什么规模、什么接口、什么预算下仍可用”。
summary.experiments: 实验应用在 LongMemEval 和 LoCoMo 上，并比较 flat、planar、hierarchical memory interfaces。全文片段没有给出具体数值表，但结论清楚：可靠性下降不是单一现象。不同接口可能有相近的 accuracy 曲线，却对应不同失败机制；有的系统在预算内快速给出错误答案，有的系统主要在遍历和验证中消耗过多 memory calls，最终触发预算耗尽。结果还显示，任何 memory scalability 声明都需要同时绑定 agent、interface、scale range 和 retrieval budget，否则固定快照分数会掩盖实际使用边界。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 15 到 20 分钟。重点看 Scale-Conditioned Agent–Memory Evaluation 中的协议定义和四个诊断指标，尤其是 Pass@B、p_exh、p_wrong 和 usable-scale boundary。实验部分主要看 flat、planar、hierarchical interface 的失败分解，而不是只看总体准确率。若关注长上下文或 RAG-agent 训练，建议进一步查看具体 scale ladder 和 retrieval-call budget 的设置，因为这些决定了结论能迁移到什么使用场景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a scale-conditioned evaluation problem for agent memory. Fixed-snapshot accuracy does not show whether evidence remains usable when the relevant sessions are held fixed but irrelevant accessible history keeps growing.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper and does not propose a new memory architecture. Its contribution is an evaluation protocol for memory-augmented agents. For foundation-model researchers, the useful point is that memory capability should not be reduced to storage capacity or single-snapshot retrieval quality. The relevant operating questions are whether the model can use evidence through a given interface, under a given call budget, at a stated memory scale.
summary_en.technical_approach: The protocol uses evidence-preserving growth. For each query, the annotated task-relevant evidence sessions are fixed, while increasing numbers of irrelevant sessions are injected according to a shared scale ladder. The measured object is the trajectory induced by an agent, a memory interface, and a retrieval-call budget. The diagnostic suite includes Pass@B for budget-compliant reliability, tail memory-call burden for high-cost cases, failure decomposition into p_exh for budget exhaustion and p_wrong for wrong answers within budget, and a usable-scale boundary where reliability first drops below a target. The framing shifts memory scalability claims from backend capacity to agent-interface usability under explicit conditions.
summary_en.experiments: The protocol is applied to LongMemEval and LoCoMo with flat, planar, and hierarchical memory interfaces. The provided text does not include the numerical result tables, but the main empirical finding is clear: reliability loss is not a single failure mode. Similar reliability curves can hide different regimes. Some systems answer incorrectly within the call budget, while others spend excessive memory calls on traversal or verification and fail by budget exhaustion. The results argue that memory-scalability claims must specify the agent, interface, scale range, and retrieval budget.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 15 to 20 minutes. Read the protocol and metric definitions in the scale-conditioned evaluation section, especially Pass@B, p_exh, p_wrong, and the usable-scale boundary. In the experiments, focus on the failure-regime decomposition across flat, planar, and hierarchical interfaces rather than only aggregate accuracy. For long-context or RAG-agent work, check the scale ladder and memory-call budget settings, since they determine how far the conclusions transfer.

recommendation.zh: 针对Agent记忆的评测方法设计更贴近真实使用场景，核心评测指标与§4的失效模式分析部分值得参考。
recommendation.en: The evaluation design for agent memory is closer to real usage scenarios; the core evaluation metrics and failure mode analysis in §4 are worth referring to.

institutions: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: Pairwise matrices for sparse autoencoders: single-feature inspection mislabels causal axes
paper.abstract: The standard sparse-autoencoder (SAE) interpretability protocol labels each feature from its top-activating contexts and validates by single-feature steering. We propose the pairwise matrix protocol, co-varying steering coefficient with joint condition, and report three findings the standard one-corner protocol misses on Qwen3-1.7B-Instruct, replicated on Gemma-2-2B-it. First, a feature labelled "AI self-disclaimer" from its top contexts produces an inverted U-shape under a coefficient sweep: at

summary.core_problem: 现有稀疏自编码器（SAE）可解释性标准协议仅通过单特征最高激活上下文标注特征、单特征扰动验证的方式，无法完整表征SAE特征的真实因果作用，存在因果轴标注偏差。
summary.importance: 修正了SAE特征单特征分析的假设缺陷，为预训练模型可解释性研究提供更严谨的探测协议，为基于SAE的模型编辑、对齐优化的实验设计提供参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出成对矩阵探测协议，同时变化特征扰动系数、多特征联合扰动两个维度，覆盖标准协议未探测的矩阵其他区域，验证特征的真实作用。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen3-1.7B-Instruct、Gemma-2-2B-it、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct三个模型上验证：1. 标注为AI免责声明的特征#26221，扰动系数扫描时免责率呈现倒U型，系数+500时模型输出变为沉思哲学家语气而非免责声明；2. 三个近正交的特征单独抑制时无明显异常，联合抑制时模型输出变为无内容的语法骨架；3. 随机方向扰动控制实验排除了离流形扰动的干扰。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看§3成对矩阵协议设计、§4核心实验结果，预计阅读时间15~20分钟，不需要深入推导过程，了解协议设计逻辑和实验结论即可。

summary_en.core_problem: The standard sparse autoencoder (SAE) interpretability protocol, which labels features only from top-activating contexts and validates via single-feature steering, cannot fully represent the true causal role of SAE features, leading to mislabeling of causal axes.
summary_en.importance: It corrects the flawed assumption of single-feature SAE analysis, provides a more rigorous probing protocol for interpretability research of pre-trained models, and offers reference for experimental design of SAE-based model editing and alignment optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed pairwise matrix protocol varies two dimensions simultaneously: steering coefficient of single feature, and joint steering condition of multiple features, covering uninspected regions of the matrix missed by the standard protocol to verify the true role of SAE features.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on three models: Qwen3-1.7B-Instruct, Gemma-2-2B-it, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct: 1. Feature #26221 labeled as AI self-disclaimer shows inverted U-shaped disclaimer rate under coefficient sweep, outputs contemplative philosopher tone instead of disclaimer when coefficient is +500; 2. Suppression of three near-orthogonal features individually causes no obvious anomaly, while joint suppression leads to content-empty syntactic skeleton outputs; 3. Random direction perturbation control rules out off-manifold perturbation interference.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on §3 pairwise matrix protocol design, §4 core experimental results, estimated reading time 15~20 minutes. No need to go through detailed derivation, just understand the protocol design logic and experimental conclusions.

recommendation.zh: 指出了 SAE 单特征 steering 的局限性，提出的 pairwise 评估方法对做 mechanistic interpretability 的研究员很有启发，建议关注其发现的非线性 steering 效应。
recommendation.en: Points out the limitations of single-feature steering in SAEs; the proposed pairwise evaluation method is highly inspiring for mechanistic interpretability researchers. Pay attention to the non-linear steering effects discovered.

paper.title: WorldMark: A Unified Benchmark Suite for Interactive Video World Models
paper.abstract: Interactive video generation models such as Genie, YUME, HY-World, and Matrix-Game are advancing rapidly, yet every model is evaluated on its own benchmark with private scenes and trajectories, making fair cross-model comparison impossible. Existing public benchmarks offer useful metrics such as trajectory error, aesthetic scores, and VLM-based judgments, but none supplies the standardized test conditions -- identical scenes, identical action sequences, and a unified control interface -- needed

summary.core_problem: 解决交互式视频世界模型缺乏统一评测条件的问题，使不同模型在相同场景、相同行为轨迹下可公平比较。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 benchmark 与评测协议统一。对做 world model、交互式视频生成和多模态统一建模的人有参考价值；对 LLM 预训练研究员的价值主要在评测设计，而不是方法本身。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 WorldMark，核心是统一动作映射层，把共享的 WASD 风格动作词表转换成各模型原生控制格式；并构建分层测试集，在相同场景和轨迹上评估六类主流 interactive image-to-video world models，结合轨迹误差、美学分数和 VLM 评判等指标。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到覆盖六个主要模型、500 个评测实例，并强调 identical scenes、identical action sequences、unified control interface 的 apples-to-apples 比较。未给出具体模型名单之外的详细数值结果。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Alaya Studio、Shanda AI Research、东京大学等机构。未见可直接确认的顶级 LLM 基座团队背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of standardized evaluation conditions for interactive video world models, so different systems can be compared under identical scenes and action trajectories.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a benchmark contribution. It is relevant to world models, interactive video generation, and multimodal unified modeling, but for LLM pretraining researchers the value is mostly in evaluation design rather than method innovation.
summary_en.technical_approach: WorldMark introduces a unified action-mapping layer that translates a shared WASD-style action vocabulary into each model’s native control format, and builds a hierarchical test suite to evaluate six major interactive image-to-video world models under identical scenes and trajectories using trajectory error, aesthetic metrics, and VLM-based judgments.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions six major models and 500 evaluation cases, emphasizing apples-to-apples comparison via identical scenes, identical action sequences, and a unified control interface. No detailed quantitative results are given in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Alaya Studio, Shanda AI Research, and the University of Tokyo, among others. No clearly identifiable top-tier LLM foundation-model lab background is evident from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在看 world model 或统一多模态生成，这篇的价值在评测协议而不在算法；正文只需看 action mapping 设计和 failure taxonomy。
recommendation.en: If you care about world models or unified multimodal generation, the value is in the evaluation protocol, not the algorithm; read the action-mapping design and failure taxonomy, then move on.

paper.title: Revisiting the Capacity Gap in Chain-of-Thought Distillation from a Practical Perspective

summary.core_problem: 在Chain-of-Thought（CoT）蒸馏中，重新审视“教师-学生能力差距（capacity gap）”是否真的是失败主因，并指出常见评测设置会掩盖蒸馏后相对学生原始能力的退化问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型为原理/评测分析与实践指南：强调应与“学生蒸馏前基线”对比而非只做“蒸馏后不同方法/教师间对比”，并给出更贴近真实落地的评测协议与教师选择建议，能直接影响小模型对齐/蒸馏的实验范式。
summary.technical_approach: 主要是实验设置与评测协议的再设计与再分析：补充蒸馏前后对照、在不同任务/不同教师强弱差异下系统复现与对比，分析capacity gap效应在实践中是否稳定主导；并讨论教师选择（强教师未必总优）与学生退化风险。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模/数据规模细节；核心实验围绕CoT蒸馏在多任务、多教师候选下的对比，关键观察是：CoT蒸馏在不少设置下会相对学生预蒸馏基线“掉点”，且capacity gap并非在所有任务/设置中一致主导；当教师之间性能差异很大时，capacity gap影响不稳定。

summary_en.core_problem: Is the teacher–student capacity gap truly the main reason chain-of-thought (CoT) distillation fails, and do common evaluation practices obscure cases where distillation degrades a student relative to its pre-distillation baseline?
summary_en.importance: Reframes how CoT distillation should be evaluated in practice by insisting on pre/post student comparisons, and offers guidance on evaluation protocols and teacher selection, highlighting that stronger teachers do not always yield better distilled students and that degradation risk is often overlooked.
summary_en.technical_approach: Redesigns the experimental protocol to include student pre-distillation baselines and systematic comparisons across tasks and teachers of varying strength, analyzing when capacity gap effects appear and when other factors dominate, and discussing practical implications for choosing teachers and avoiding student regression.
summary_en.experiments: Across multiple tasks and multiple teacher candidates, the study finds that CoT distillation can reduce performance compared to the original student in many settings, and that the influence of capacity gap is not consistently dominant—especially when teacher performance differences are large. The abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, or exact deltas.

recommendation.zh: 改变我对“capacity gap 是 CoT 蒸馏主因”的默认归因：强制用学生蒸馏前基线做对照；建议立刻把他们的评测协议搬进内部蒸馏实验。
recommendation.en: It updates the default blame on “capacity gap” in CoT distillation by insisting on student-pre-distill baselines; you should adopt their evaluation protocol in your own distillation runs.
